title: QA & Release Engineering Manager
description:
We are seeking a hands-on QA & Release Engineering Manager to raise the quality bar across our software delivery process and help build a disciplined, scalable QA function. This person will actively test software, lead QA practices and standards, expand test automation, and ensure releases are validated and deployed safely and predictably.



This is not a coordination-only management role. The ideal candidate is an experienced QA or quality engineer who can set expectations for the QA team while remaining technically hands-on with testing, automation, CI/CD, deployments, and release troubleshooting. The role combines QA leadership, quality engineering, release management, and practical DevOps responsibility.



Core Responsibilities

QA Leadership, Standards & Discipline

• Own and continuously improve the QA process across the product and engineering organization.

• Establish clear QA standards for test planning, execution, regression testing, defect reporting, evidence, retesting, and sign-off.

• Set a high and consistent quality bar for the QA team and coach team members on effective testing practices.

• Ensure QA work is systematic, reproducible, documented, and traceable rather than dependent on informal or ad-hoc testing.

• Define what must be validated for different types of changes and ensure appropriate test coverage before release.

• Review QA results and challenge incomplete testing, weak defect reproduction, or unsupported sign-off.

• Identify recurring gaps in QA execution and drive corrective process improvements.

• Help establish useful QA metrics such as escaped defects, regression failures, reopen rates, automation coverage, and recurring defect categories.

• Work constructively with Engineering and Product while maintaining independent authority to determine when quality requirements have not been met.



Hands-On Quality Assurance

• Personally perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and release testing as needed.

• Create and maintain test plans and test cases for new functionality, regressions, integrations, and critical workflows.

• Validate acceptance criteria and verify that completed engineering work behaves correctly across relevant environments and scenarios.

• Produce clear, actionable defect reports with reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, supporting evidence, and appropriate severity.

• Ensure defects are properly retested and regressions are covered before closure.

• Focus QA effort based on product risk, customer impact, change scope, and historical failure patterns.



QA Automation & Quality Engineering

• Own and expand meaningful automated regression coverage across the product.

• Determine which tests should be automated and which are better suited to manual or exploratory testing.

• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot automated UI, API, integration, and regression tests as appropriate.

• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure they run at the correct stages of software delivery.

• Establish automated quality gates that prevent progression or release when required tests fail.

• Track flaky tests, automation failures, coverage gaps, and recurring regressions and drive them to resolution.

• Work with Engineering to ensure unit and engineering-level tests remain an engineering responsibility while QA provides broader product, integration, and regression assurance.

• Continuously reduce repetitive manual QA work where reliable automation provides better coverage and faster feedback.



Release Ownership & Deployment Control

• Own or directly support the end-to-end release process from QA readiness through production deployment and validation.

• Establish and enforce clear Definition of Release Ready and Definition of Release Complete standards.

• Confirm required code reviews, tests, scans, approvals, documentation, QA sign-off, deployment steps, and rollback preparation are complete before release.

• Plan, coordinate, execute, and validate production releases across relevant application components.

• Maintain release schedules, release manifests or records, release notes, deployment evidence, and rollback procedures.

• Identify release risks and dependencies early and escalate blockers before they affect delivery.

• Have the authority and judgment to stop or delay a release when required quality or readiness criteria have not been met.

• Ensure failed or partially completed releases have clear recovery and rollback procedures.

CI/CD, DevOps & Deployment Automation

• Own and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting build, test, security validation, packaging, and deployment.

• Maintain and improve Bitbucket repositories, Git workflows, branching practices, pull-request workflows, and pipeline integrations as they relate to quality and releases.

• Automate deployments across development, QA/staging, and production environments.

• Reduce manual deployment steps and opportunities for human error while preserving appropriate controls.

• Ensure pipelines provide clear visibility into failures and prevent unsafe deployments.

• Support and troubleshoot Docker/containerized application environments and deployment workflows.

• Support and oversee deployments into AWS environments, including configuration, permissions, dependencies, logs, monitoring, and deployment health.

• Help maintain consistency across development, QA/staging, and production environments and troubleshoot environment-related failures with Engineering.



Security, Release Validation & Production Follow-Through

• Integrate and maintain automated security, dependency, vulnerability, and code-quality scanning within the delivery pipeline.

• Define how critical test, security, and code-quality findings affect release readiness.

• Define and execute post-deployment smoke tests and validation procedures.

• Verify that releases are functioning correctly before considering deployment complete.

• Monitor deployment health, errors, logs, and other production signals following releases.

• Coordinate rapid response, rollback, or remediation when a release introduces problems.

• Lead or participate in post-release reviews and ensure quality or release failures result in concrete corrective actions.

• Maintain a clear audit trail showing what was released, when, by whom, and with which validations.



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong hands-on software QA experience in a production SaaS, web application, or similarly complex software environment.

• Experience leading QA practices, setting testing standards, or serving as a senior/lead QA engineer responsible for the quality bar of a team.

• Strong understanding of test strategy, functional testing, regression testing, exploratory testing, integration testing, defect management, and release validation.

• Hands-on experience building or maintaining automated software tests, ideally including API, integration, regression, and/or browser-based testing.

• Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience managing or directly supporting software releases and production deployments.

• Strong experience with Git workflows, branches, pull requests, and repository management; Bitbucket experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience building, maintaining, or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.

• Working knowledge of AWS and cloud deployment environments.

• Ability to troubleshoot failed builds, pipelines, automated tests, environment problems, and deployments.

• Understanding of rollback strategies, release risk management, and production i
 response.

• Ability to distinguish between QA responsibilities and engineering responsibilities and hold both functions to appropriate quality standards.

• Strong attention to detail, disciplined follow-through, and low tolerance for undocumented, unverified, or casually bypassed quality steps.

• Ability to coach others, enforce standards constructively, and communicate clearly when work is not ready to progress.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Nice to Have

• Previous experience as a QA Lead, QA Manager, Senior QA Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, SDET, Release Engineer, or similar hands-on quality role.

• Experience managing or mentoring a distributed QA team.

• Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines.

• Experience with Docker or containerized deployments.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code and AWS deployment automation.

• Experience with automated security, vulnerability, dependency, or static-analysis scanning.

• Familiarity with PHP, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, and web application architectures.

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools.

• Experience improving an existing QA organization where processes, automation, or release discipline needed to mature.

• Experience supporting distributed engineering and QA teams.



Ideal Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior QA practitioner who wants ownership, not someone who views QA management as primarily assigning test work or tracking tickets. They are comfortable getting directly involved in difficult testing, reproducing defects, reviewing automation, troubleshooting pipelines, and validating releases.



They can walk into an existing QA process, identify where discipline or coverage is weak, establish practical standards, coach the team to meet them, and measure whether quality is actually improving. They know when a defect indicates an isolated issue and when it points to a broader gap in testing, engineering checks, or release controls.

They also understand the software delivery process beyond QA: why a build failed, why a test should block deployment, how environments differ, how a release should be packaged and validated, and where CI/CD or deployment automation can eliminate risk and manual work.



They are comfortable saying that a release is not ready when required standards have not been met, while working constructively with Engineering, Product, and QA to resolve the issue quickly.



Success in this role means the QA team becomes more disciplined and effective, automated coverage increases where it matters, fewer defects escape into production, and releases become more predictable, auditable, and automated over time.

description:
Hi!



I’m looking for a reliable full-time E-commerce Operations Assistant to help with daily operations for a growing online store in the U.S. market.



The business is expanding, and I need someone hands-on who can help with customer communication, supplier follow-ups, product research, pricing checks, Shopify tasks, product listings, SEO edits, and keeping operations organized.



This is a growing business, so I am looking for someone who can grow with the company. New ideas, suggestions, and process improvements are welcome, especially after you understand how our systems work.



Experience with high-ticket e-commerce stores would be a strong advantage. This includes stores that sell expensive products, supplier-direct items, freight products, multi-brand catalogs, products with warranties, products with different lead times, or products where customer communication and accuracy are very important.



We sell high-ticket products, not a simple one-product dropshipping item. We work with multiple brands and suppliers, and each brand can have different prices, margins, shipping rules, product details, lead times, warranties, and return policies.



Many products are shipped directly from suppliers or manufacturers, so attention to detail is very important.



This is a full-time position, and it is not a “work whenever you want” role. Since this position involves customer emails, SMS, calls, supplier follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and order updates, you must be available during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time.



The first week will focus on training, onboarding, and learning how our process works. We may use Zoom calls, Google Meet calls, training videos, SOPs, examples, and internal documents to explain tasks clearly.



You are encouraged to ask questions when something is unclear. I prefer someone who asks before guessing, especially when dealing with customers, suppliers, pricing, shipping, returns, warranties, or order issues.



As the business grows and you prove you are reliable, responsibilities can increase and pay can also increase based on performance.



Main tasks may include:



Responding to customer emails, SMS, and calls in English, including order updates, product questions, quote follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and general customer support.



Making and answering customer calls in English when needed.



Following up with customers by call, SMS, or email for quotes, pending payments, abandoned checkouts, product questions, delivery updates, and order issues.



Following up with suppliers about stock, pricing, shipping, product details, lead times, tracking, freight delivery, warranty cases, and order updates.



Updating customers about order status, delivery updates, supplier responses, delays, and next steps.



Checking product prices, supplier costs, margins, shipping costs, MAP rules, and competitor pricing.



Comparing our prices with U.S. competitors.



Using a VPN when needed to view U.S. pricing, competitor websites, and product availability.



Helping with Shopify product uploads and product updates.



Creating, editing, and improving Shopify product listings using supplier information.



Reviewing product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, warranty details, shipping details, and product page accuracy.



Helping identify missing product information, incorrect specs, weak descriptions, pricing issues, or product pages that need improvement.



Reviewing product pages for missing or incorrect information.



Keeping CRM sheets and internal spreadsheets organized.



Updating customer notes, supplier notes, order notes, lead status, and follow-up status.



Helping with warranty, return, cancellation, delivery, and supplier communication.



Assisting with documentation for warranty claims, returns, delivery issues, disputes, and chargebacks when needed. This may include organizing emails, screenshots, order details, tracking information, supplier communication, customer communication, and timelines. Final decisions on refunds, disputes, cancellations, compensation, or discounts are handled by management.



Handling customer problems professionally and knowing when to escalate an issue before making promises or decisions.



Following SOPs and training videos for each task.



Suggesting improvements to processes, product pages, customer communication, follow-ups, spreadsheets, or SOPs after learning how the business works.



You will not be expected to know everything on day one. I will assign specific tasks and provide instructions, examples, and training videos when needed.



Requirements:



Please do not apply if you do not think you qualify.



Advanced written and spoken English for U.S. customer communication.



Confident speaking with U.S. customers by phone in clear, professional English.



Please only apply if you are comfortable handling conversations in English with U.S. customers, including questions, follow-ups, problems, delays, delivery concerns, warranty issues, and customer complaints.



Spoken English will be verified through a short Zoom, Google Meet, or similar video call during the hiring process.



Comfortable answering calls, making follow-up calls, replying to SMS, and handling customer issues professionally.



Able to communicate clearly when there is a problem, delay, warranty issue, delivery concern, or customer complaint.



Experience with Shopify, e-commerce operations, customer support, product listings, SEO edits, pricing checks, or virtual assistant work.



Experience with high-ticket e-commerce stores, supplier-direct shipping, freight products, warranty cases, returns, or multi-brand online stores is strongly preferred.



Experience using Google Sheets, CRM sheets, spreadsheets, or similar tools to stay organized.



Able to work with the U.S. market and U.S. customers.



Available full-time during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, for customer calls, SMS, emails, supplier follow-ups, Shopify tasks, and order updates.



Must have reliable internet.



Must be able to use a VPN when needed.



Strong attention to detail.



Organized and able to keep accurate notes.



Able to follow step-by-step instructions carefully.



Comfortable checking supplier websites, product pages, pricing, shipping details, and competitor pages.



Able to ask questions when something is unclear instead of guessing.



Able to work with urgency when a task is assigned.



Able to suggest useful ideas, improvements, or better ways to organize work after understanding the business process.



Must understand that refunds, cancellations, discounts, returns, disputes, or compensation cannot be approved without owner approval.



Experience using Slack or similar communication tools is a plus, but not required.



Important:



This business sells high-ticket products, so mistakes can be expensive. A wrong product detail, wrong price, missed follow-up, or incorrect promise to a customer can create serious problems.



You should not promise customers exact delivery dates unless they are confirmed. You should not approve refunds, returns, cancellations, discounts, disputes, or compensation unless I specifically authorize it.



You must be careful when checking prices because different brands have different margins, supplier costs, shipping fees, MAP rules, and competitor pricing.



This is not a simple task-based role where you only reply to messages. I am looking for someone who can help keep operations organized, follow processes, communicate professionally, and grow into more responsibility over time.



Examples of tasks you may receive:



“Check if this product is in stock with the supplier and confirm the shipping cost.”



“Reply to this customer asking for a delivery update.”



“Call this customer and confirm their shipping address.”



“Call or text this customer who started checkout but did not complete the order.”



“Follow up with this lead and ask if they have any questions before purchasing.”



“Compare our price with this competitor and calculate the margin.”



“Update the CRM sheet with the customer status and next follow-up.”



“Check this Shopify order/customer profile and update the CRM sheet with the latest status.”



“Check if this product page is missing warranty, shipping, or specification details.”



“Upload these products to Shopify using this supplier page.”



“Review this product listing and improve the title, description, specifications, SEO title, and meta description.”



“Organize this supplier information in the supplier database.”



“Follow up with this supplier about tracking or freight delivery.”



“Review this customer issue and prepare a draft response.”



“Organize documents and communication related to a warranty claim, return, delivery issue, dispute, or chargeback.”



How to apply:



Please message me here if you are interested.



To show that you read the full post carefully, start your message with:



“Hi Chris, I can help with U.S. e-commerce operations.”



Also, somewhere in your application, mention:



“CRM sheet”



If possible, please include a short video or voice recording speaking in English. This can be a Loom video, Google Drive link, or any similar link where I can hear you speak clearly.



This is not required, but it will strongly help your application and hiring decision. In the video, please briefly introduce yourself, explain your e-commerce/customer support experience, and mention if you have experience with high-ticket products, supplier-direct shipping, freight items, warranty cases, returns, or multi-brand online stores.



It would also be very helpful if you explain your experience with Shopify product listings, including product uploads, product titles, descriptions, specifications,  SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, pricing updates, or reviewing product pages for missing information.



You can also explain how you would handle customer issues such as delayed orders, delivery concerns, warranty problems, refund requests, or customers asking for exact delivery dates.



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer these questions in your own words. I want to understand your real experience, communication style, and judgment, so please do not use AI-generated responses.



1. Have you worked with Shopify, customer service, or e-commerce operations before? Explain briefly.



2. Have you worked with high-ticket e-commerce products, supplier-direct shipping, freight items, or multi-brand online stores before? If yes, please explain your experience.



3. Are you comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone in English?



4. Are you available full-time during U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, for assigned tasks, calls, SMS, emails, and follow-ups?



5. Have you used Google Sheets, CRM sheets, or spreadsheets to manage customer/order information?



6. Have you used Slack or similar communication tools before?



7. Have you helped create, edit, or improve Shopify product listings before? If yes, what parts have you handled? For example: product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, or pricing.



8. If you have worked with other e-commerce stores before, what is one process, system, product page, or customer communication workflow you helped improve?



9. A customer asks for an exact delivery date, but the supplier only gave an estimated transit time. How would you respond?



10. Before telling a customer that a product is in stock, what would you check?



11. If a customer asks for a refund, discount, cancellation, return, dispute update, or compensation, what would you do before confirming anything?



12. Are you able to use a VPN to check U.S. competitor pricing and product availability?



13. Are you willing to do a short Zoom or Google Meet call so we can verify your spoken English and communication skills?



If you have any questions before applying, feel free to include them in your message. I will be reviewing applications and answering questions through the chat.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Thanks!



Chris

title: Sales Support & Customer Success Specialist | Shopify & U.S. Customers
description:
Full-Time | Remote | U.S. E-commerce | Long-Term Position



We are a growing U.S.-based e-commerce company selling high-ticket products across categories such as portable power stations, solar equipment, e-bikes, outdoor living products, spas, shelters, power equipment, and other specialty products.



We are looking for a reliable, organized, proactive Sales Support & Customer Success Specialist to join our team long term.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position and it is not an
-only customer service role.



You will work alongside an existing Customer Support team member and share many of the same day-to-day responsibilities.



The goal is to make sure customer inquiries, orders, supplier follow-ups, sales opportunities, and unresolved issues do not depend on only one person.



As you learn the business, you will also help with pricing research, competitor monitoring, product performance, and identifying new sales opportunities.



You are not expected to know all of our products on Day 1. We will provide training, internal documentation, supplier information, and clear priorities.



What You Will Do



Your main responsibilities will include:



Answer customer phone calls, SMS messages, and
s

Help customers with product questions, availability, pricing, specifications, shipping, warranties, and order status

Recognize buying signals and help move qualified customers toward a purchase

Follow up with leads who requested pricing, availability, shipping quotes, product information, or discounts

Review Shopify orders and customer history before responding

Check order status, payment status, fulfillment status, customer details, products, variants, and notes

Contact manufacturers and suppliers to verify inventory, lead times, freight costs, product specifications, tracking, replacement parts, and warranty information

Follow up with suppliers if they do not respond

Monitor open orders and proactively update customers instead of waiting for them to contact us

Follow preorder, backorder, tracking, freight, and delivery cases

Help coordinate freight shipments and delivery requirements

Collect photos, videos, serial numbers, and other information needed for warranty or damaged-product cases

Keep accurate customer notes, statuses, and next follow-up dates

Follow unresolved cases until there is a clear resolution

Flag urgent orders, payment situations, expiring authorizations, or other time-sensitive issues

Escalate unusual refunds, cancellations, chargebacks, large discounts, payment concerns, or sensitive customer situations when appropriate

Help maintain organized customer and order records

Support the other Customer Support team member when workload is high, and receive support from them as well



We want both team members to eventually be able to cover most of the same core responsibilities.



Ownership Is Extremely Important



If you tell a customer:



“I’ll check with the supplier and get back to you.”



That becomes your responsibility.



You should:



Verify the information, contact the appropriate supplier or manufacturer, record what is pending, follow up again if necessary, update the customer, and continue until the situation has been resolved.



We do not want a customer to contact us three days later because someone forgot to follow up.



A major part of this position is closing the loop.



Never Guess



This is one of the most important rules in our company.



Do not promise or assume:



Inventory

Shipping dates

Delivery dates

Freight costs

Discounts

Product specifications

Warranty outcomes

Replacement approval

Supplier availability



If something has not been confirmed, say that you need to verify it.



We value an accurate answer with good follow-up much more than a fast answer that turns out to be incorrect.



Many of our products cost several thousand dollars. A small mistake can become an expensive problem.



Sales Is Part of the Position



We are not looking for an aggressive salesperson.



We want someone who understands that excellent customer service naturally creates sales opportunities.



For example, if a customer asks:



“Is this in stock?”



“How quickly can I receive it?”



“Can you offer a better price?”



“How much is shipping to my ZIP code?”



“Which model is better for me?”



the customer may already be very close to purchasing.



We want someone who knows how to:



Ask useful follow-up questions

Understand what the customer actually needs

Collect their contact information

Research the correct answer

Follow up quickly

Present the product clearly

Ask whether they would like to move forward

Continue following the opportunity until there is an outcome



If the customer does not know the exact SKU, your first reaction should not simply be to tell them to find it and call back.



Use the information they provide to help identify the product whenever possible.



Product, Pricing & Competitor Research



Customer support and sales support will be your primary responsibilities.



However, as you learn the business, you will also spend part of your time helping us understand what is happening in the market.



This may include:



Reviewing our product pricing

Comparing our prices with other U.S. retailers

Checking U.S. Google Shopping results

Looking at competitor websites

Comparing shipping offers

Comparing promotions or discounts

Checking whether competitors have the same product in stock

Identifying products or brands generating strong interest

Helping identify potential “winning” products or brands

Identifying products that used to sell but have slowed down

Investigating possible reasons sales declined

Checking whether pricing may be too high

Looking for stock or availability problems

Checking whether competitors are offering a better deal

Reporting product or pricing discrepancies

Identifying opportunities that management should review



You will not be responsible for making major pricing or purchasing decisions.



Your role is to notice, research, document, and communicate useful information.



Over time, we want you to naturally start asking questions such as:



Why is this product selling?



Why did this product stop selling?



What is the customer seeing from competitors?



What can we improve?



Are we missing a better product or offer?



U.S. Market Research



Our customers are primarily located in the United States.



Because of this, having access to a reliable VPN with U.S. server locations is preferred.



This can help you review:



U.S. Google Shopping results

U.S. search results

Competitor pricing

Promotions

Product visibility

The customer experience from the U.S. market

Shopify Experience



Shopify experience is highly valuable for this position.



We are especially interested in candidates who have experience with things such as:



Reviewing orders

Checking payment status

Checking fulfillment status

Reviewing customer information

Reviewing addresses

Checking order notes

Looking up products and variants

Tracking orders

Assisting with draft orders

Discounts

Customer service

Order management

Supplier fulfillment



You do not need to know every Shopify feature.



We care more about whether you understand how e-commerce operations work and can learn quickly.



Communication Requirements



Excellent spoken and written English is required.



You will regularly communicate directly with customers in the United States.



You do not need to have an American accent.



However, your spoken English must be:



Fluent

Clear

Natural

Professional

Easy for U.S. customers to understand



You should be comfortable speaking without relying entirely on a script.



You may need to:



Speak with customers on live calls

Ask follow-up questions

Explain order situations

Handle frustrated customers

Explain delays

Discuss products worth several thousand dollars

Speak with suppliers

Call manufacturers

Call shipping or freight companies

Follow up on missing tracking

Discuss shipping requirements



Good written English alone is not enough for this position.



Professional Communication



When speaking with customers, you are representing our company.



We want someone who can be friendly and personable while still remaining professional.



You should use verified company information, follow company policies, and avoid making unnecessary personal statements or assumptions.



Good judgment matters.



Schedule



This is a full-time, Monday through Friday position, 40 hours per week.



The schedule corresponds to:



10:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time during Daylight Saving Time



9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time during Standard Time



You must be consistently available throughout your scheduled shift.



Because this position includes live customer calls, you must have:



Reliable high-speed internet

Reliable computer equipment

A good headset or microphone

A quiet and professional working environment

Minimal interruptions during working hours

Consistent attendance

Good punctuality



This is intended to be a serious long-term position.



Compensation



Starting compensation is approximately:



$4 USD per hour



Compensation may be negotiable depending on:



Previous experience

Spoken English

Customer service experience

Sales experience

Shopify experience

E-commerce experience

Overall fit



Strong performance can lead to increased compensation and additional responsibilities.



There may also be performance-based bonuses or additional compensation when your work meaningfully contributes to closing high-ticket sales.



We care about results, ownership, accuracy, follow-up, and contribution to the business.



We are not measuring performance only by the number of
s answered.



Experience We Value



Experience in any of the following is valuable:



Customer Support

Customer Success

Sales Support

Inside Sales

E-commerce

Shopify

U.S. customer phone support

CRM systems

Order management

Supplier communication

Vendor communication

Freight coordination

Product research

Competitor research



Experience with the following is a plus:



Shopify

Gmail

Google Sheets

Google Drive

Business phone systems

CRM platforms

Google Shopping

AI productivity tools



Technical product knowledge is helpful but not required.



You do not need to memorize thousands of products.



You need to know how to research, verify, understand, communicate, and follow through.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please read this section carefully.



For this hiring step, do not use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another AI writing tool to generate, rewrite, polish, or improve your application answers.



We use AI tools in our own business, so using AI itself is not something we consider negative.



However, during this application step, we want to evaluate:



Your own English

Your own reasoning

Your own writing style

Your judgment

Your attention to detail

Your ability to follow instructions



Your application does not need to sound perfect.



We would rather receive a natural answer written by you than an artificially perfect application generated by AI.



To confirm that you carefully read this job post, your application must begin with the exact words:



Customer first, details always

before making a promise

VOICE OR VIDEO RECORDING REQUIRED

In Your Recording, Cover These Three Parts

HOW TO APPLY

title: FULL-TIME WORDPRESS DEVELOPER & SEO WEBSITE MANAGER
description:
Remote —  Full-Time | $1,000 USD/Month



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking a reliable and technically strong **WordPress Developer & SEO Website Manager** to take primary responsibility for the ongoing health, maintenance, security, and performance of our WordPress websites and hosting environment.



The most important responsibility of this role is keeping our websites and server environment properly maintained and proactively identifying issues before they become larger problems.



You will regularly work inside **WP Engine** to monitor and maintain our WordPress sites, update WordPress core, themes, plugins, and PHP versions, test websites after updates, monitor for security or performance issues, and work directly with WP Engine support when hosting or technical problems arise.



In addition to technical website maintenance, you will make routine content updates, publish blog posts, optimize website pages for SEO and AI search visibility, and assist with other WordPress development needs as they arise.



You will work directly with our project leadership team and receive clear priorities, written instructions, and ongoing direction. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, communicates proactively, tests their work carefully, and alerts the team quickly when they identify technical, security, hosting, or website issues.



This is a hands-on website management role, not simply a support or ticket-response position.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



WordPress Maintenance & Website Health



Your primary responsibility will be keeping our WordPress websites secure, updated, stable, and functioning properly.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor and maintain all WordPress websites on an ongoing basis.

* Keep WordPress core versions current.

* Update WordPress themes and plugins.

* Monitor and update PHP versions as needed.

* Test websites thoroughly after updates.

* Identify plugin conflicts, broken functionality, display issues, or errors.

* Monitor website speed, uptime, and overall technical health.

* Check for outdated or unsupported plugins and themes.

* Identify potential website or server security concerns.

* Proactively communicate technical issues, risks, or recommendations.

* Maintain backups and confirm restoration options are available when needed.

* Troubleshoot issues before escalating when possible.

* Document significant maintenance, updates, or technical changes.



WP Engine Hosting Management



A significant part of this role involves working directly inside WP Engine.



You will:



* Manage development, staging, and production environments.

* Perform website backups and restores.

* Push changes between staging and production environments.

* Review WP Engine technical alerts and recommendations.

* Troubleshoot website and hosting issues.

* Work directly with **WP Engine support** when problems require hosting-level assistance.

* Follow up with support until issues are fully resolved.

* Monitor PHP compatibility and hosting requirements.

* Investigate server errors, performance issues, caching problems, SSL issues, DNS-related problems, and other hosting concerns.

* Clearly communicate the issue, resolution, and any recommended next steps to our team.



We need someone who is comfortable reaching out to technical support rather than allowing unresolved hosting issues to remain open.



WEBSITE SECURITY



You will help maintain the security of all websites and proactively identify potential vulnerabilities.



Responsibilities may include:



* Monitor website security using tools such as **Wordfence**.

* Identify suspicious login attempts or website activity.

* Conduct routine plugin and theme security reviews.

* Remove or replace outdated or vulnerable plugins.

* Assist with credential management and password updates.

* Monitor SSL certificates and website security warnings.

* Investigate malware, redirects, spam, or suspicious website behavior.

* Escalate security concerns immediately.

* Coordinate with WP Engine support or other vendors when needed.



WEBSITE CONTENT UPDATES



You will also be responsible for routine website updates requested by our team or clients.



This may include:



* Updating website copy.

* Replacing images.

* Adding or updating team members.

* Updating services or product information.

* Creating or modifying website pages.

* Updating forms and calls to action.

* Updating navigation menus.

* Adding downloadable resources.

* Making layout or formatting changes.

* Troubleshooting broken links or website elements.



You should be comfortable working with WordPress builders and frameworks including:



* Elementor

* Avada

* Gutenberg

* ACF

* Custom WordPress themes

* PHP, HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript



BLOG PUBLISHING



You will publish blog content provided by our marketing or content teams.



Responsibilities include:



* Format and publish WordPress blog posts.

* Apply proper heading hierarchy.

* Add and optimize images.

* Add internal and external links.

* Add calls to action.

* Configure categories and tags.

* Create appropriate URLs.

* Add featured images.

* Optimize blog posts for desktop and mobile.

* Check posts before publication.

* Confirm links and formatting are working correctly.



SEO & AI SEARCH OPTIMIZATION



You will help ensure website pages and blog posts follow current SEO and AI-search best practices.



Responsibilities include:



* Optimize page titles and meta descriptions.

* Review heading structure.

* Optimize URLs.

* Add image alt text.

* Improve internal linking.

* Implement schema and structured data where appropriate.

* Work with plugins such as **Yoast SEO or RankMath**.

* Monitor indexing and website errors in Google Search Console.

* Assist with keyword optimization.

* Review technical SEO issues.

* Apply **AIO, AEO, and GEO** best practices.

* Structure content for visibility within:



  * Google Search

  * Google AI Overviews

  * ChatGPT

  * Other AI-powered search and answer engines



This may include implementing:



* FAQ schema

* HowTo schema

* Answer-first content structures

* Clear heading hierarchy

* Structured data

* Internal entity relationships

* Improved crawlability and content clarity



Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console is preferred.



WORDPRESS DEVELOPMENT



While this role is primarily focused on website maintenance and management, you should also be comfortable handling development tasks when needed.



This may include:



* Building new WordPress pages.

* Modifying website templates.

* Creating or editing reusable modules.

* Working with ACF custom fields.

* Making PHP, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript updates.

* Troubleshooting theme or plugin code.

* Working with GitHub repositories.

* Creating branches and pull requests.

* Testing changes in staging environments.

* Implementing third-party integrations.

* Connecting websites with CRM, booking, scheduling, or marketing platforms.



API & PLATFORM INTEGRATIONS



Experience working with APIs and integrations is important.



You may work with platforms such as:



* GoHighLevel

* Booking and scheduling platforms

* CRM systems

*
 marketing platforms

* Lead-generation forms

* Zapier or similar automation platforms

* Google services

* Analytics and tracking systems



Direct experience with GoHighLevel is a strong advantage.



USING AI TOOLS



We actively use AI tools to increase productivity and expect our developer to be comfortable doing the same.



Tools may include:



* ChatGPT

* Claude / Claude Code

* GitHub Copilot

* Cursor

* Other AI development tools



AI may be used to:



* Troubleshoot WordPress problems.

* Analyze code.

* Debug plugin conflicts.

* Develop PHP, CSS, or JavaScript.

* Research technical solutions.

* Improve SEO implementation.

* Assist with schema and structured data.

* Speed up repetitive development work.



You must still understand, review, test, and take responsibility for everything you deploy.



REQUIRED SKILLS



We are looking for someone with:



* 3+ years of hands-on WordPress experience

* Strong experience maintaining live WordPress websites

* Experience managing WordPress core, themes, plugins, and PHP updates

* Experience working inside **WP Engine or a similar managed WordPress hosting platform**

* Strong troubleshooting skills

* WordPress security experience

* Understanding of backups, staging environments, and production deployments

* Experience with Elementor, Avada, Gutenberg, ACF, or custom themes

* Working knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

* Experience with Yoast, RankMath, or similar SEO tools

* On-page and technical SEO experience

* Understanding of AIO, AEO, GEO, or AI-search optimization

* Experience with Google Search Console

* Experience working with APIs or third-party integrations

* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub

* Experience using AI tools in real development work

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to test your work before reporting that it is complete

* Strong troubleshooting and research skills

* Good written and conversational English

* Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to non-technical team members



NICE-TO-HAVE EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* GoHighLevel

* WP Engine

* Wordfence

* Advanced Custom Fields

* Sage / Blade WordPress framework

* WPML

* SEMrush

* Google Analytics

* Google Search Console

* Google Tag Manager

* Schema markup

* Core Web Vitals

* Canva

* Notion

* Website accessibility

* Conversion tracking

* CRM integrations

* Marketing landing pages

* DNS and domain management

* Cloudflare



THE WORK STYLE WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, and takes ownership of website health.



You should:



* Check websites carefully rather than waiting for users to report problems.

* Proactively identify technical or security concerns.

* Notify the team quickly when an issue is discovered.

* Follow through until problems are resolved.

* Contact WP Engine or other technical support teams when needed.

* Test updates before considering work complete.

* Communicate clearly about what was changed.

* Document important technical work.

* Ask thoughtful questions when instructions are unclear.

* Research unfamiliar problems rather than immediately giving up.

* Be comfortable learning new systems.

* Accept feedback professionally.

* Follow established processes.

* Take responsibility for assigned work.



We value someone who says, “I found an issue, here is what I discovered, here is what I have already done, and here is what I recommend next,” rather than simply reporting that something is broken.



HOURS & WORKING ARRANGEMENT



* Full-time contractor position

* Fully remote

* Philippines-based candidates preferred

* Full-time working hours required

* Some flexibility in how you structure your workday

* Availability for scheduled team meetings

* Regular overlap with **Houston, Texas Central Time business hours**

* Reliable high-speed internet required

* Professional environment suitable for Google Meet and team calls



Full-time contractor position.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following with your application:



1. Your name and location.

2. A brief summary of your WordPress experience.

3. How many years you have professionally managed or developed WordPress websites.

4. Your experience managing WordPress updates, including core, themes, plugins, and PHP.

5. Your experience working with WP Engine or another managed WordPress hosting provider.

6. An example of a serious website, hosting, plugin, or security issue you identified and how you resolved it.

7. Links to **3–5 WordPress websites** you have developed or substantially managed, along with an explanation of your responsibilities.

8. Your experience with Elementor, Avada, Gutenberg, ACF, PHP, or custom WordPress themes.

9. Your experience with Wordfence or other website security tools.

10. Your SEO experience, including Yoast, RankMath, Search Console, SEMrush, schema, or technical SEO.

11. Your understanding or experience with AIO, AEO, GEO, or AI-search optimization.

12. Your experience working with APIs or third-party integrations.

13. Your experience with GoHighLevel, if applicable.

14. Which AI development tools you use and one specific example of how you used AI to solve a real technical problem.

15. Your current availability and confirmation that you are seeking full-time work.

16. Your availability to overlap with Houston, Texas Central Time.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a reliable long-term member of our team and taking ownership of the technical health of our websites.



If you enjoy maintaining WordPress websites, solving technical problems, improving website performance and security, and proactively keeping sites running smoothly, we would like to hear from you.

title: Google Pod & Merchant Center Specialist

Main responsibilities

Research: Analyze demand and trends to pick a niche with strong, rising momentum, and study competitor stores for high-converting patterns to model.

Set up: Provision a business phone line with a voi
, create a branded business

In Manila that is 12:00am to 8:00am (1:00am to 9:00am while the US is on daylight time, March to November). This is fixed. Please only apply if you can genuinely work these hours every week.



What Vea does

Vea Health is a US telehealth company. We work with a growing network of partners (coaches, trainers, gym owners, clinicians, and creators) who refer their clients to us and earn a commission. When a partner joins, they get a personal referral code, a landing page, and support from our team.



What you will do

You are the person our partners talk to after they join. Your job is to make sure every partner gets a fast, warm, useful reply, and that each one gets from "just signed up" to "made their first referral."



Answer partner messages by text,
, and chat inside our CRM (GoHighLevel). First reply within one hour during your shift, and the whole overnight queue cleared by 10:00am Pacific.

Walk new partners through setup: collect their headshot, bio, and shipping address, confirm their code works, and get their landing page live within a week.

Coach partners toward their first referral using our playbook: check their audience fit, suggest what to post, send fresh creative, and follow up.

Re-engage partners who have gone quiet.

Send the weekly partner
 and help run a monthly partner webinar (invites, reminders, follow-up).

What we are looking for

Experience with a CRM. GoHighLevel is a plus but not required; you can learn it in a week if you have used HubSpot, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar.

Organised and self-directed. You will manage a queue on your own during US afternoon hours.

Comfortable with the fixed schedule above. This is not flexible.

What we offer

Full-time, stable hours, biweekly pay via Wise through Gusto.

Monthly performance bonus tied to partner activation (partners who reach their first referral).

Direct line to the founders. Small team, fast decisions.

A real playbook and CRM already built, not a blank page.

 or form]. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor
description:
JOB TITLE: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor – Real Estate and Relocation Channel



ABOUT US



We are a husband-and-wife real estate team serving the Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas area. Our YouTube channel helps people who are relocating to DFW understand its cities, neighborhoods, new-construction communities, homes, and lifestyle.



YouTube is an important part of our business. Our goal is not simply to publish videos or accumulate views. We want to create genuinely helpful content that earns trust and encourages qualified viewers to contact us when they are ready to buy or sell a home.



We are looking for a dependable, creative long-form YouTube video editor to join our team for a long-term working relationship.



ABOUT THE POSITION



You will edit approximately eight long-form YouTube videos per month, averaging two completed videos per week.



Our videos generally fall into two categories:



• Informational videos about DFW cities, suburbs, neighborhoods, new construction, relocation, local development, and real estate

• Home tours and new-construction community tours



Most finished videos will be approximately 8–20 minutes long.



This is not a short-form social media editing position. Your primary responsibility will be producing polished, engaging long-form YouTube videos.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Edit approximately eight long-form YouTube videos per month

• Turn raw footage into organized, engaging finished videos

• Remove mistakes, excessive pauses, repetition, and unnecessary sections

• Improve pacing without making the videos feel rushed or overedited

• Help make the opening 30–60 seconds as engaging as possible

• Find relevant B-roll, stock footage, photos, maps, screenshots, and supporting visuals

• Use B-roll to explain the subject and maintain viewer attention

• Add tasteful text, titles, callouts, transitions, music, graphics, and sound effects when appropriate

• Perform basic color correction, audio cleanup, and volume balancing

• Use maps and location graphics to help viewers unfamiliar with the DFW area

• Properly license and organize any stock footage, images, music, or other outside assets

• Follow our established visual and editing style

• Organize project files so they can be accessed again when needed

• Submit drafts on schedule and complete revisions promptly

• Export and deliver completed videos according to YouTube specifications

• Communicate questions, missing assets, and potential delays before they become problems

• Review channel analytics and feedback when provided to help improve future edits



OUR PREFERRED EDITING STYLE



We want our videos to feel:



• Professional

• Conversational

• Trustworthy

• Informative

• Visually interesting

• Well-paced

• Clean and polished



We do not want every sentence filled with effects, zooms, captions, memes, or distracting transitions. Editing choices should support the information, strengthen the story, or help maintain viewer attention.



We will provide examples from our current channel and other YouTube channels whose editing styles we like.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos

• Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, and viewer retention

• Ability to edit both talking-head informational videos and home tours

• Ability to find relevant, high-quality B-roll without needing detailed instructions for every visual

• Strong attention to detail

• Good written and spoken English

• Ability to follow instructions and maintain a consistent style

• Comfortable receiving constructive feedback and making revisions

• Organized and able to manage multiple videos at different production stages

• Reliable communication and ability to meet weekly deadlines

• Reliable computer, internet connection, and file-storage system

• Familiarity with copyright, music licensing, and stock-footage usage



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



These are helpful but not required:



• Experience editing real estate, relocation, travel, community, educational, or documentary-style YouTube content

• Experience editing property and model-home tours

• Experience creating maps and location-based graphics

• Familiarity with YouTube audience-retention reports

• Basic motion-graphics experience

• Experience using 
, Dropbox, Google Drive, or another collaborative review system

• Ability to recommend editing improvements based on viewer-retention data



EDITING SOFTWARE



You may use:



• Adobe Premiere Pro

• DaVinci Resolve

• Final Cut Pro

• After Effects or similar motion-graphics software



Please identify the programs you use when applying.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



• Remote position

• Approximately eight long-form videos per month

• Average production pace of two completed videos per week

• Consistent, ongoing work for the right person

• Compensation based on experience and portfolio quality

• Some availability during U.S. Central Time for meetings and communication

• A paid trial project will be required before we make a long-term commitment



The editor must have enough weekly availability to meet our publishing schedule consistently. Please disclose any other full-time positions or major ongoing clients that could affect your availability.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “MANSFIELD VIDEO” so we know you read the complete job description.



Please provide the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Links to three long-form YouTube videos that you personally edited

3. At least one example of a talking-head, educational, travel, real estate, or property-tour video

4. A description of exactly what you handled on each example

5. The editing programs you use

6. Your average turnaround time for a 10–15 minute YouTube video

7. Your current weekly availability

8. Any other jobs or ongoing clients you currently have

9. Your expected monthly compensation for eight long-form videos

10. Your internet speed and computer specifications

11. Your preferred method of receiving and transferring large video files



Please also answer these three questions:



1. If viewers are leaving during the first 30 seconds of a video, what would you examine or change in the edit?



2. How do you d
 when a talking-head video needs B-roll or another visual?



3. What is one long-form YouTube channel whose editing you admire, and what do you like about its editing?



Applications without relevant long-form video samples will not be considered.



HIRING PROCESS



Selected applicants will be invited to a video interview.

6 Short-Form Videos

* Is organized, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.

* Can consistently meet weekly content deadlines.



Sample Content Style



We’re looking for content similar in style, pacing, and structure to these examples:

Securing Degrees helps students and families navigate the scholarship process through scholarship opportunities, technology, accountability, essay support, and coaching—with a mission to Make Free College the New Normal.

title: Experienced Funding Manager — Business Funding
description:
**Experienced Funding Manager & Appointment Setter — Business Funding**



We are hiring an experienced **Funding Manager & Appointment Setter** to qualify leads, book consultations, manage client files, build funding strategies, and guide clients through business funding applications.



This is a combined role. You must be comfortable following up with prospects and booking qualified appointments while managing active clients through the funding process.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who already understands credit repair, funding applications, lender requirements, and client communication.



Our company helps entrepreneurs and business owners improve their credit profiles and secure funding. We’re looking for someone who can keep leads and client files moving professionally, accurately, and efficiently.



**Responsibilities**



**Appointment Setting & Lead Follow-Up**



* Contact leads through calls, texts, emails, and approved messaging channels.

* Qualify prospects based on funding needs, credit profile, business history, and readiness to move forward.

* Explain our services clearly without promising approvals or specific funding amounts.

* Book qualified consultations on our team’s calendar.

* Send appointment confirmations and reminders.

* Follow up with unresponsive leads, missed appointments, and prospects who need more time.

* Answer common questions and handle initial objections professionally.

* Keep accurate notes, lead statuses, and follow-up tasks in our CRM.

* Work toward agreed goals for outreach, qualified appointments, and attendance.



**Funding Management & Client Support**



* Review client credit reports and assess funding readiness.

* Understand how utilization, inquiries, late payments, collections, charge-offs, and tradelines affect funding options.

* Help create funding plans based on credit, income, business profile, banking history, and lender requirements.

* Identify credit issues that need attention before applying.

* Collect and organize client documents.

* Prepare clients for applications and explain next steps.

* Assist with or submit funding applications where permitted, using proper client authorization and accurate information.

* Communicate with clients, banks, lenders, and funding partners.

* Track approvals, denials, pending applications, conditions, and funding amounts.

* Update client records and application statuses in our CRM.

* Follow up consistently on missing documents and outstanding requirements.

* Help improve our appointment-setting and funding processes.



**Required Experience**



You must already have experience with:



* Appointment setting, lead qualification, and prospect follow-up.

* Speaking with prospects by phone and handling common objections.

* Credit repair and credit report review.

* Business funding and personal credit-based funding.

* Credit card funding, business credit cards, and lines of credit.

* Funding applications and client file management.

* CRM systems, calendar scheduling, and application tracking.

* Bank or lender communication.

* Working remotely and handling sensitive financial information securely.



Experience with 0% APR funding, business credit building, underwriting, or funding broker operations is a major plus.



**Important Requirements**



We are looking for someone who is:



* Confident and professional on the phone.

* Clear and responsive in written communication.

* Organized enough to balance lead follow-up with active funding files.

* Detail-oriented when reviewing documents and applications.

* Reliable with daily outreach, reminders, and client updates.

* Comfortable following scripts, checklists, and established workflows.

* Able to explain funding steps clearly.

* Honest, professional, and accountable.



You must handle client information securely and complete applications only with proper consent and accurate information. False information, misleading promises, and questionable tactics are not acceptable.



**Compensation & Schedule**



* **Pay:** $5–$8 per hour, depending on experience.

* **Additional compensation:** Commission/bonus per successful funding file.

* **Position type:** Part-time to full-time.

* **Location:** Remote.

* **Start date:** ASAP.



This can grow into a long-term role for the right person.



**To Apply**



Please answer these five questions:



1. Briefly describe your experience with credit repair, business funding, and appointment setting.

2. What funding products have you helped clients get approved for, and what was your role in the application process?

3. How do you qualify leads, book appointments, and follow up with prospects who don’t respond?

4. What tools or systems have you used to manage leads and active client funding files?

5. What is your availability, time zone, and requested hourly rate? Are you comfortable with $5–$8/hour plus commission/bonuses per successful funding file?



**Ideal Candidate**



The ideal candidate has worked for a credit repair company, funding company, funding broker, or financial services business and has hands-on experience with both appointment setting and funding operations.



You can turn an inquiry into a qualified appointment, maintain consistent follow-up, and help clients move from credit review to funding strategy, applications, and decisions.



We want someone who can come in ready, follow our process, communicate well, and help us book more qualified appointments and complete more funding files.

title: Client Success Manager / Funding Coordinator
description:
**Client Success Manager / Funding Coordinator**



**Remote | $5–$8/hour + Commission/Bonuses | Part-Time to Full-Time | Start ASAP**



We are hiring a **Client Success Manager / Funding Coordinator** to manage client communication, organize documents, track funding applications, and keep clients moving through our process.



Our company helps entrepreneurs and business owners improve their credit profiles and secure business funding. We need someone who is organized, proactive, and consistent with follow-up so every client knows what happens next.



**Your primary responsibility will be day-to-day client management and funding coordination.** You will work with our team to execute established funding plans and keep client files organized from onboarding through funding decisions.



**Responsibilities**



* Onboard new clients and clearly explain the process and required documents.

* Serve as the main point of contact for client questions, updates, and follow-ups.

* Collect and organize credit reports, business information, and supporting documents.

* Review files for completeness and flag missing information to our team.

* Coordinate application steps based on the funding strategy provided.

* Help clients complete applications accurately, with proper authorization and in accordance with our process.

* Track application statuses, approvals, denials, lender conditions, and funding amounts.

* Follow up with clients, lenders, and funding partners on outstanding items.

* Keep our CRM updated with accurate notes, documents, deadlines, and next steps.

* Identify stalled files and escalate issues that need management attention.

* Keep clients informed throughout the process without promising approvals or funding amounts.

* Help improve our onboarding, follow-up, and client service workflows.



**Required Experience & Skills**



* Previous experience in client success, account management, loan processing, or a similar client-facing coordination role.

* Strong phone,
, and written communication skills.

* Experience managing multiple client files, deadlines, and follow-up tasks.

* Comfortable using CRM systems, scheduling tools, and online document platforms.

* Ability to follow established processes and maintain accurate records.

* Confidence handling sensitive personal and financial information securely.

* Reliable internet access and a professional environment for client calls.

* Ability to work independently and communicate promptly with our team.



**Preferred Experience**



Experience in **business funding, credit repair, lending, or financial services** is strongly preferred.



Helpful knowledge includes:



* Credit reports and common factors affecting funding readiness.

* Business credit cards, personal credit-based funding, and lines of credit.

* Funding applications and lender documentation requirements.

* GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.



You do not need to independently develop funding strategies, but you must be able to learn our process, follow instructions carefully, and recognize when a file needs additional review.



**Bonus Skill: Appointment Setting**



Appointment-setting experience is a plus, but it is not required. If you have experience qualifying leads, booking consultations, sending reminders, or following up with prospects, please mention it in your application.



**Who We’re Looking For**



You take ownership of follow-up, keep accurate records, and make sure clients understand their next steps. You can balance a friendly client experience with the persistence needed to collect documents and move files forward.



Professionalism and honesty are essential. Client information must be handled securely, and applications must use accurate information and proper client consent.



**Compensation & Schedule**



* **Hourly pay:** $5–$8, depending on experience.

* **Additional compensation:** Commission/bonus per successful funding file.

* **Schedule:** Part-time to full-time.

* **Location:** Remote.

* **Start date:** ASAP.

* **Opportunity:** Long-term growth for the right person.



**To Apply**



Please answer these five questions:



1. Describe your experience managing clients or coordinating files, including any work in business funding, credit repair, lending, or financial services.

2. How do you keep multiple client files organized and make sure follow-ups and deadlines are not missed?

3. A client has not sent the documents needed to move forward. Write a brief follow-up message you would send.

4. What CRMs and other tools have you used? Please also mention any funding application or appointment-setting experience.

5. What is your availability, time zone, earliest start date, and requested hourly rate? Are you comfortable with $5–$8/hour plus commission/bonuses per successful funding file?

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Instagram Reels, Youtube Shorts, Tiktok)
description:
Short-Form Video Editor / 2D + 3D Animator (For Organic Social Media Content & Paid AD Creatives)



Read this whole post before you apply.



Scaliency is a growth marketing agency in Phoenix. We run paid ads, organic content, and full funnels for 25+ local service businesses and personal brands. We're hiring editors to clip, color and edit creatives + add sound effects — the kind of work that has to stop a scroll and drive a lead, not just look nice.



The bar



These are the editing standards we're hiring against. Watch them before you go any further:



* 

* 

* 

* 

* 

* 

* 

* 

* 



If you can't produce work at that level, don't fill out the form. We're not looking for basic CapCut cuts, stock zoom-ins, or auto-captions slapped on a talking head. We're looking for editors who understand pacing, sound design, animation, retention, and how an ad is actually structured.



Non-negotiable requirements



You must be a 2D animator — motion graphics, kinetic type, animated icons, logo animation, UI/screen animation, character or illustration animation

You must have 3D Animation experience — 3D product renders, camera moves, environments, text and object animation (Blender, Cinema 4D, or equivalent)

A portfolio showing both 2D and 3D work at or above the level of the examples above



If you only edit, or only animate in 2D, we still encourage you to apply. We do however place emphasis on those who can take a concept from raw footage to a finished animated ad.



What you'll be doing:



- Editing short-form organic content + paid ad creative (Instagram Reels, Youtube Shorts, Youtube Videos, Tiktok videos). 

- 2D motion graphics, 3D animation, text animation, sound design, and clean coloring of video (from Raw files)

- Working from briefs and/or scripts and iterating fast on feedback and performance data

- Cutting multiple variations of a winning concept for testing



What we're looking for:



- Fluency in Premiere and After Effects, plus Blender or Cinema 4D

- Fast turnaround without a drop in quality

- Someone who takes direction, communicates clearly, and hits deadlines



What we pay:



Market or Above Market Rate on a per video basis for editors who perform and demonstrate skill. We'd rather pay one great editor/animator well than manage five below-average editors. Rate depends on your portfolio, speed, and the scope of work you take on — bring your number and your portfolio.



How to apply:



Fill out the form and include a link to your portfolio with both 2D and 3D examples. Applications without a portfolio are deleted immediately. If your reel is all wedding videos, vlogs, or basic subtitle edits, this isn't the role for you.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (4K Nature & Wildlife Channel)
description:
I'm seeking a skilled video editor to assist in creating long-form YouTube videos that feature 4K wildlife, animals, nature, and landscapes, accompanied by relaxing background music.

  Showcasing beautiful, crystal-clear 4K nature and wildlife footage

Example Videos



The videos we create should have a similar style, pacing, and atmosphere to examples like these:























Please review these examples before applying so that you understand the type of content and editing style I'm looking for.



Workload



- 4 videos per month (1 per week)

- Videos between 1–2 hours long

- Ideally, around 2 hours when enough high-quality footage is available

- Shorter videos are acceptable when suitable stock footage is difficult to find or insufficient

- Potential to increase to up to 8 videos per month in the future



Requirements



DaVinci Resolve is required.



The videos need to be edited in DaVinci Resolve because color grading and certain Resolve features will be an important part of the workflow.



Computer



You must have a powerful PC capable of comfortably handling long 4K projects, including:



- 4K 60fps footage

- Long 1–2 hour timelines

- 4K 60fps playback and editing

- 4K 60fps rendering/exporting

- Optical Flow processing

- Noise Reduction processing

- Large amounts of high-resolution stock footage



Please include your full PC specifications in your application, including CPU, GPU, RAM, and storage.



Internet



A fast and reliable internet connection is required.



You will regularly download large amounts of 4K stock footage from platforms such as Envato Elements and Artlist, so please include your download and upload speeds when applying.



I will provide access to Envato Elements and Artlist.



What I'm Looking For



The ideal editor can:



- Select beautiful, high-quality 4K footage

- Create smooth, natural, relaxing pacing

- Match visuals naturally with relaxing background music

- Maintain excellent visual clarity throughout the video

- Perform professional color grading in DaVinci Resolve

- Make footage from different sources look visually consistent

- Use Optical Flow to create smooth motion

- Use Noise Reduction when needed to improve footage quality

- Avoid repetitive clips

- Create a seamless and immersive viewing experience



There are no talking heads, subtitles, motion graphics, or complex visual effects required.



The focus is on beautiful visuals, professional color grading, visual clarity, relaxing pacing, and premium image quality.



Compensation

€1.25 per finished minute



Examples:



60-minute video = €75

100-minute video = €
minute video = €150



Performance Bonuses – Cumulative



100K views → +€25

250K views → +€50

500K views → +€100

The bonuses are cumulative.



For example, a 100-minute video that reaches 1 million views would earn:



€125 base pay

+€25 at 100K

+€50 at 250K

+€100 at 500K

+€200 at 1M



Total: €500

WILDLIFE4K

title: MARKETPLACE PPC SPECIALIST | EBAY & WALMART
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Starbond is looking for a Marketplace PPC Specialist to grow our eBay and Walmart channels through advertising automation, disciplined performance management, and data-driven optimization.



This is not a general PPC role. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience managing advertising and marketplace performance on eBay and/or Walmart.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Configure and maintain advertising automation, campaign rules, controls, and structures for eBay and Walmart.

Monitor advertising spend, attributed revenue, ROAS, ACOS, CVR, CTR, and total marketplace sales.

Improve campaign structure, targeting, automation logic, and controls based on performance data.

Diagnose performance drops, automation failures, and campaign issues.

Identify listing, pricing, inventory, offer, or creative issues affecting conversion and flag them to the appropriate team.

Maintain clear records of material campaign and automation changes.

Provide concise weekly performance updates with issues, actions taken, and recommended next steps.

Complete monthly performance reviews against established channel targets.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Demonstrated experience managing eBay advertising, Walmart Connect, or Walmart marketplace advertising.

Strong understanding of marketplace PPC metrics including ROAS, ACOS, CVR, CTR, spend, and attributed sales.

Experience using campaign rules, automation tools, or structured PPC automation.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability.

Ability to identify root causes and recommend action rather than simply reporting numbers.

Strong ownership and follow-through.

Comfortable working independently and keeping campaign changes and performance visible.

Ability to work within approved budgets and strategy.



IMPORTANT SCOPE

This role does not own:

Amazon advertising or Amazon marketplace management.

People management.

Hiring or team-performance management.

Independent budget or strategy changes outside approved limits.

Repetitive manual bid-by-bid optimization as the normal operating model.



ENGAGEMENT

Part-time Independent Contractor.

Remote, Philippines.

Approximately 4–6 hours per day.

Heavier setup work may be required initially, with a lower maintenance load once automation is stable.

Department: Marketing.

Reports to the CEO.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

Which platforms you have personally managed: eBay, Walmart, or both.

Examples of marketplace PPC accounts or campaigns you have worked on.

One example where you improved ROAS, ACOS, CVR, or revenue.

An example of an advertising automation or rule system you built or managed.

A situation where marketplace performance suddenly declined and how you diagnosed the cause.

Your current availability and expected hourly rate.



Applications focused primarily on Google Ads, Meta Ads, or Amazon PPC without meaningful eBay/Walmart experience may not meet the requirements for this role.

s (Canva or similar)

Who We’re Looking For

Why Join AJG Transport?

• Measurable growth opportunities within a scaling freight brokerage.
