title: Client Delivery Manager (Project Manager)
description:
Client Delivery Manager | Full-Time - Remote



The role in one paragraph

Your job is to make sure every client request and every video, script and thumbnail project moves from submission to delivery without being missed, delayed or left without an owner. You are the operational owner for a portfolio of clients: visible in Slack, coordinating the internal team, keeping Airtable true, resolving blockers and raising risks before the client feels them. This is not a passive task-tracking role. You are the person who makes sure the work actually moves and every loop closes.



About Views To Clients



Views To Clients is a fast-growing YouTube growth and production company working with some of the world's leading founders and brands, including Gary Vee, Manychat and Instantly.ai. We are building the strongest YouTube delivery operation in the market and need high-ownership operators who can keep pace with that ambition.



What you own:

Own the day-to-day delivery health of a portfolio of clients.

Be present in client Slack channels, acknowledge operational requests and give clear progress updates.

Turn client messages, submissions and decisions into properly owned work with a clear deadline.

Coordinate scriptwriters, editors, QAs, thumbnail designers, strategists and other internal owners.

Make sure new work is assigned the same day and accepted by the person responsible.

Track projects through delivery, chase progress and intervene before an issue becomes a missed deadline

Keep Airtable and the operating system aligned with reality at all times.

Identify blockers and weak plans early, then resolve or escalate them with a proposed next action

Verify that the correct result reaches the client before marking anything resolved.

Maintain clear daily visibility across what is healthy, at risk, overdue and unresolved.



Where the role stops

The Strategist owns YouTube strategy and results direction. QA and functional leaders own the quality standard inside their disciplines. Client Success leadership owns higher-stakes relationship calls, renewals, saves, expansion and commercial decisions.



You do not need to personally execute every specialist task, but you cannot treat another person's ownership as a reason for a client outcome to drift. Your job is to route the issue correctly, secure a credible commitment and make sure it reaches resolution.



Who will be exceptional here

You have strong agency project-management, client-delivery or creative-operations experience.

You have controlled several recurring client workstreams and cross-functional teams at once.

You naturally notice missing owners, vague deadlines and silent risks before somebody points them out.

You are direct, calm and comfortable holding talented people accountable.

Your written English and client communication are excellent.

You can prioritise quickly when several clients need attention at once.

You use systems such as Airtable, Asana, ClickUp or Monday as operational truth, not decoration.

You ask questions early, make sensible decisions without waiting for permission and close loops without being chased.



What success looks like

Clients do not need to chase us for status.

Actionable requests are captured and assigned within the required SLA.

Risks are raised before deadlines are missed.

Every live item has a clear owner, next action and deadline.

The system matches the real state of delivery.

Internal owners know exactly what is expected and by when.

Problems reach the client as controlled solutions, not silent surprises.

title: AI Automation Architect & GoHighLevel Systems Builder
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Automation Architect to help build a coordinated system of nine AI employees for a healthcare, education, consulting, marketing, and business-development organization.



This is not a basic virtual-assistant position. We need a hands-on technical builder who can translate business processes into reliable AI employees, GoHighLevel workflows, 
 automations, API integrations, prompts, safeguards, approval systems, and clear documentation.



ABOUT THE PROJECT



Our first implementation will support AWAREmed Health & Wellness Resource Center. However, the underlying system is being designed so it can later be configured for additional businesses and clients.



The system will include nine coordinated AI employees:



1. ARIA — AI Chief of Staff and Orchestrator

   Coordinates the other AI employees, prioritizes work, prepares reports, and escalates decisions requiring human approval.



2. SENTINEL — Compliance and Quality Guardian

   Checks communications, permissions, healthcare claims, privacy requirements, and escalation rules before actions are completed.



3. PORTER — Front Door and Reception

   Responds to initial inquiries, identifies the person’s needs, collects approved information, and routes each inquiry correctly.



4. SCOUT — Lead Research and Qualification

   Researches and qualifies prospects using approved scoring criteria, organizes lead information, and identifies the appropriate next step.



5. SALES AND FOLLOW-UP EMPLOYEE

   Manages lead nurturing, follow-up sequences, reactivation campaigns, opportunity tracking, and handoffs to a human team member.



6. APPOINTMENT AND PATIENT COORDINATION EMPLOYEE

   Assists with scheduling, reminders, confirmations, missed appointments, intake steps, and approved patient communications.



7. EXECUTIVE SECRETARY EMPLOYEE

   Organizes meetings, tasks, summaries, follow-ups, communications, priorities, and administrative workflows.



8. MARKETING AND CONTENT EMPLOYEE

   Supports
 campaigns, social media, educational content, reputation management, funnels, campaign tracking, and content repurposing.



9. ACCOUNTING AND OPERATIONS EMPLOYEE

   Organizes invoices, expenses, reports, payment follow-up, financial-document workflows, operational dashboards, and QuickBooks-related processes. All financial actions must follow human-approval rules.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



* Build and maintain advanced GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, calendars, forms, funnels, tags, custom fields, triggers, and communication sequences.

* Build 
 scenarios connecting GHL, AI models,
, calendars, forms, spreadsheets, accounting systems, and other approved applications.

* Integrate OpenAI and Claude through APIs.

* Work with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, error handling, and data mapping.

* Store and manage prompts, configurations, documentation, and version history in GitHub.

* Use Netlify for approved lightweight pages, forms, demonstrations, or internal tools.

* Create structured Company Brain knowledge files and role-specific instructions.

* Build human-approval steps so AI employees cannot send sensitive communications or take high-risk actions without authorization.

* Create clear permissions for what each AI employee may read, draft, recommend, or execute.

* Create audit trails showing what happened, when it happened, and which human or AI employee initiated it.

* Test every workflow thoroughly before activation.

* Monitor automations, identify failures, correct problems, and prevent duplicate or conflicting actions.

* Protect confidential business information and follow HIPAA-aware procedures.

* Record short training videos and create step-by-step SOPs so the owner and operations team understand the system.

* Provide weekly progress reports showing completed work, current problems, test results, and the next deliverables.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE



Applicants must have practical experience with:



* GoHighLevel, including advanced workflows and CRM configuration

* 
 scenario building

* OpenAI or Claude API integrations

* APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth or API-key authentication

* Git and GitHub

* Prompt engineering and structured AI instructions

* Error handling, logging, testing, and troubleshooting

* Google Workspace integrations

* Clear technical documentation and SOP creation



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



* Netlify or similar deployment platforms

* QuickBooks integrations

* Healthcare or other regulated industries

* HIPAA-aware automation

* Multi-client or multi-location GHL environments

* AI agents or coordinated multi-agent systems

* YAML, JSON Schema, JavaScript, or Python

* Lead qualification, marketing automation, sales pipelines, and appointment systems



IMPORTANT ARCHITECTURAL REQUIREMENTS



The successful candidate must follow our established Build Contract:



* GoHighLevel is the Version 1 system of record.

* 
 is the Version 1 automation runtime.

* GitHub protects and versions the system’s intellectual property.

* We are building a configurable AI employee system—not an unnecessary custom SaaS application.

THE RIGHT PERSON

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

title: Full-Time AI Automation Developer | n8n, AI Agents, Python/JavaScript, GitHub
description:
FULL-TIME AI AUTOMATION & FULL-STACK DEVELOPER

n8n | AI Agents | OpenClaw | Hermes | Claude Code | Codex | Grok | GitHub



We are hiring a dedicated developer to work directly with the founder and build, deploy, maintain, and improve AI agents, business automations, internal tools, dashboards, and web applications.



You must be capable of taking a business idea, clarifying the requirements, recommending a practical approach, building the solution, and keeping it working after launch.



POSITION DETAILS



• Employment: Full-time, long-term, remote.

• Compensation: $2,000–$3,500 USD per month, depending on demonstrated experience and technical ability.

• Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Saturday.

• Working overlap: At least 3 agreed hours each day overlapping with US Eastern Time. Remaining hours are flexible.

• Start date: Following a successful paid technical trial and any agreed notice period.

• Tools: Company-approved development tools, API usage, and hosting are paid separately.



FULL-TIME, EXCLUSIVE COMMITMENT — REQUIRED



This position is for someone who wants to become part of our team, take ownership, and build with us over the long term.



This is not a temporary position, a side job, or a project-by-project engagement. We are hiring an individual who is ready to make us their only employer/client during the engagement.



You must be willing to:



• Commit 40 working hours per week to this role.

• End other employment, paid freelance client work, and ongoing agency commitments before your agreed start date.

• Personally perform the work without outsourcing or subcontracting.

• Maintain consistent availability during the agreed schedule.

• Stay involved after launch to troubleshoot, maintain, and improve what you build.



If you intend to maintain multiple jobs, split your working time between clients, or accept outside client projects during this engagement, do not apply.



Currently employed applicants may apply if prepared to transition fully into this role. State your notice period and earliest exclusive start date.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD



Projects may include:



• n8n workflows connecting business applications and automating recurring tasks.

• AI agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete defined business processes.

• OpenClaw and Hermes deployments with custom tools, skills, and integrations.

• Internal dashboards, reporting tools, and administrative applications.

• Web applications and portals connected to databases and backend services.

• Integrations between CRMs,
, messaging platforms, calendars, documents, and other business systems.

• Adaptations of suitable open-source GitHub projects.



You will work from an agreed priority list with clear milestones. You should be comfortable recommending when to use an existing tool, adapt an open-source project, or write custom software.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS



1. n8n AND WORKFLOW AUTOMATION



You must be able to build and troubleshoot workflows beyond basic templates.



Required capabilities:



• Webhook, scheduled, and event-triggered workflows.

• HTTP requests, REST APIs, JSON, and data transformation.

• API keys, OAuth, and credential management.

• Conditional logic, branching, loops, and reusable sub-workflows.

• Custom JavaScript or other supported code steps.

• Pagination, rate limits, timeouts, retries, and error handling.

• Duplicate prevention so repeated events do not create repeated actions.

• Execution logs, failure alerts, and workflow troubleshooting.

• Connecting workflows to databases, CRMs,
, messaging, and other applications.

• Maintaining and updating workflows without disrupting existing processes.



2. AI AGENT DEVELOPMENT



You must have built working agents that perform tasks through tools or integrations.



Required capabilities:



• Tool calling and structured outputs.

• Connecting agents to APIs and business applications.

• Retrieving relevant information from documents or databases.

• Managing conversation state, context, and persistent memory appropriately.

• Designing multistep workflows with clear completion criteria.

• Adding approval steps before sensitive or consequential actions.

• Handling failed tool calls, invalid outputs, and incomplete tasks.

• Setting execution limits to prevent runaway loops and unnecessary spending.

• Testing whether an agent completes its intended task reliably.

• Understanding when a predictable automation is more appropriate than an agent.



3. OPENCLAW AND HERMES



Hands-on experience with both is required. State your experience with each separately.



You should be able to:



• Install, configure, and run the system.

• Connect supported model providers and tools.

• Configure available integrations, skills, memory, and scheduled tasks.

• Customize or extend functionality for a defined use case.

• Diagnose configuration, authentication, dependency, and runtime problems.

• Manage updates and document the deployment.

• Explain what you personally built or configured.



4. CLAUDE CODE AND CODEX



You must be comfortable using both as part of a software development workflow.



You should be able to:



• Work inside an existing repository.

• Give coding tools clear requirements and project context.

• Review generated code and identify incorrect assumptions.

• Run tests, debug failures, and verify functionality.

• Inspect changes before committing or deploying them.

• Explain the code and architecture you deliver.

• Maintain and modify the system without depending on blindly generated output.



5. MODEL API INTEGRATIONS



Experience integrating Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI, and xAI/Grok is required.



You should understand:



• Authentication, model selection, and request configuration.

• Tool calling and structured responses.

• Context limits, token usage, rate limits, and timeouts.

• Error handling and appropriate fallback behavior.

• Tracking usage and estimating operating costs.

• Choosing a model based on task requirements, reliability, speed, and cost.



6. PROGRAMMING AND BACKEND DEVELOPMENT



Strong proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript is required.



You must be able to:



• Write, read, debug, and maintain custom code.

• Build backend services and API endpoints.

• Work with asynchronous tasks and external integrations.

• Validate inputs and handle errors clearly.

• Manage dependencies and environment configuration.

• Write meaningful tests for important functionality.

• Read unfamiliar codebases and make controlled changes.



7. DATABASES AND DATA HANDLING



You should have practical experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or an equivalent system.



Required capabilities:



• Designing appropriate tables and relationships.

• Reading, inserting, updating, and querying records.

• Managing schema changes and migrations.

• Maintaining data consistency and avoiding duplicate records.

• Applying appropriate access permissions.

• Backing up and restoring application data.

• Connecting databases to applications, workflows, and agents.



8. GIT AND GITHUB



You must be comfortable managing real development work through GitHub.



Required capabilities:



• Cloning, evaluating, and adapting existing repositories.

• Understanding project dependencies, maintenance status, and license restrictions before reuse.

• Working with branches, commits, pull requests, and code reviews.

• Resolving merge conflicts and reverting problematic changes.

• Tracking issues and documenting setup instructions.

• Keeping API keys, credentials, and private data out of repositories.

• Configuring or maintaining basic automated checks and deployment workflows, including GitHub Actions when appropriate.



9. FULL-STACK APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT



You must be able to connect a usable interface to a working backend.



Required capabilities:



• Building responsive dashboards, forms, and administrative interfaces.

• Using a modern frontend framework such as React/Next.js or an equivalent.

• Implementing authentication and appropriate user permissions.

• Connecting interfaces to APIs and databases.

• Handling loading, empty, success, and error states.

• Verifying that buttons, forms, navigation, and data updates work end to end.

• Troubleshooting problems across the frontend, backend, and database.



10. DEPLOYMENT AND SYSTEM MAINTENANCE



You must be able to deploy and support what you build.



Required capabilities:



• Working with cloud hosting or Linux servers.

• Using the command line and reading application logs.

• Configuring environment variables and credentials securely.

• Working with Docker or comparable deployment tooling.

• Setting up domains and HTTPS when needed.

• Monitoring availability, failures, and resource usage.

• Managing backups, updates, and recovery procedures.

• Maintaining a practical rollback plan for significant changes.

• Documenting enough detail for another developer to operate the system.



EXPERIENCE AND WORKING STYLE



We are looking for:



• Approximately 3+ years of software development experience, or equivalent evidence of substantial shipped projects.

• Demonstrated experience with AI agents and business automation.

• Ability to work independently on clearly defined objectives.

• Clear written and spoken English.

• Willingness to ask questions before making consequential assumptions.

• Honest estimates and early communication about blockers.

• Attention to reliability, usability, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

• Ability to recommend simpler solutions when they meet the business need.

• Reliable internet and a computer suitable for development work.



HOW WE WORK



• Tasks are prioritized with the founder.

• Deliverables include working software, verification, and documentation.

• Provide a brief daily update covering completed work, next steps, and blockers.

• Give a weekly demonstration of working progress.

• Keep code, workflows, project files, and deployment accounts under company ownership.

• Get approval before introducing new paid services or materially increasing operating costs.

• Use sample or test data during development where appropriate.

• Maintain the systems you deliver and address issues during agreed working hours.



INITIAL SUCCESS EXPECTATIONS



During the first month, you should be able to:



• Understand our initial priorities and recommend a practical implementation plan.

• Establish organized repositories, development environments, and deployment documentation.

• Deliver an agreed first automation or agent with working integrations.

• Demonstrate handling of failures and repeated inputs.

• Explain the solution, its limitations, and its operating costs.

• Leave clear instructions for setup, maintenance, and recovery.



Specific deliverables will be agreed based on project scope.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this application subject:



AI Developer — [Your Name] — Full-Time Exclusive



Include ALL of the following:



1. Your résumé, location, and time zone.



2. Your desired monthly compensation in USD.



3. Your available start date, required notice period, and proposed working hours in US Eastern Time.



4. Two relevant working projects you personally built. Explain the problem, your contribution, the tools used, and whether the system is currently in use.



5. A 3–5 minute video demonstrating an n8n workflow or AI agent you built. Show how it works and explain one technical challenge you solved.



6. Your GitHub profile or a walkthrough of private code you have permission to share. Identify your own contributions.



7. Your experience with each of the following separately:

   n8n, OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, xAI/Grok API, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, databases, GitHub, and deployment.



For each, distinguish professional use, personal projects, and no experience. Do not claim experience you cannot demonstrate.



8. One example of a system failure you diagnosed and fixed.



9. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a small paid technical trial.



10. Include this statement:



“I understand this is a long-term, full-time, exclusive role. If hired, I will make this my only employer/client, end other paid work commitments before my agreed start date, commit 40 hours per week, and personally perform the work.”



SELECTION PROCESS



• Application and project-evidence review.

• Technical interview and walkthrough of your own work.

• A small live modification or troubleshooting exercise.

• A scoped paid technical trial for finalists, with payment and expectations agreed beforehand.



AI coding tools are allowed during the evaluation. You must understand, explain, test, and take responsibility for the work.



Applications without the requested project evidence and exclusivity confirmation will not be considered. Tutorial-only examples and lists of tool names are insufficient.



Share only work and code you have permission to disclose.

title: Media Buyer Specialist (PH)
description:
PH - Media Buyer Specialist



We're looking for a Media Buyer Specialist to own the performance and impact of a large book of complex, custom paid media campaigns for our practices — leading strategy, setup, optimization, and communication with practices and cross-functional teams to get results.



You'll also be stepping into using AI as leverage — scaling both the quality and volume of your work by recognizing patterns, making good bets, and playing to exploit every advantage, rather than relying on automated platforms or SOPs to do the thinking for you.



Ad buying is changing fast. This role exists for someone who understands data, tracking, and the full funnel deeply enough to know when to follow our best practices and when to trust their own judgment — and who's ready to own the outcome either way. Getting this right lets the rest of our media team focus on their own work instead of constantly course-correcting an underperforming book.



Our objectives for the role

- Own the performance of a large, complex book of campaigns, around 50 initially and scales up with time — from strategy and setup through optimization — and be accountable for the outcome, whether you followed our playbooks or your own judgment to get there.

- Build deep command of our reporting and tracking systems so you can pull your own data, diagnose account health quickly and accurately, and manage risk proactively before it shows up in results.

- Use AI as leverage to run more accounts at a higher level — treating media buying as a competitive game of pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven testing, and educated bets – to drive results you’ll own.

- Contribute best practices and workflows — like a new setup approach or AI-assisted process — that get adopted as standard team practice.

- Use your understanding of the full funnel we deploy and your excellent communication skills to influence clients and cross-functional teams towards better performance for the campaigns you own.



We're looking for:

- Ownership and accountability — you take full responsibility for a large book of accounts' results, regardless of whether you followed an SOP or your own judgment to get there.

- Autonomy and judgment — you know when to lean on established playbooks and when to deviate, and you're comfortable making that call independently.

- Optimization and testing rigor — you approach media buying like a competitive game: pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven tests, and educated bets, not guesswork.

- Tracking and reporting command — you can pull your own data and diagnose account and tracking health quickly, without waiting on someone else to hand you a report.

- Productive use of AI — you use AI to scale the volume and quality of your work, but you don't let it replace your own judgment on what actually moves the needle.



Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- This is a role built for media buyers who want to own outcomes, not just execute tickets — full autonomy over a book of accounts, real say in when to follow SOPs versus your own judgment, and credit for the results either way.

- It's an IC track with real influence: your work shapes team playbooks and best practices, without requiring you to manage people to get that influence.

- You'll work within a high-caliber team where iron sharpens iron — challenging, fast-paced, and genuinely fun if you like this game.

- Competitive salary

Out of Site Bookkeeping is a fast-growing, client-focused bookkeeping firm dedicated to helping small businesses succeed. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, supportive culture and our commitment to continuous improvement. Join a team where your expertise and leadership will be valued!

title: Personal Executive Assistant to VP
description:
About me: I'm the VP of a luxury short-term rental property management company in New England. Things move fast and my brain has about 47 tabs open at any given time — I need a right hand who can catch what I toss out and just... handle it.



You'd work for me, personally, as my own assistant who helps me run my work and life more smoothly.



I'm looking to send a message "can you remind me to follow up with that owner Friday?" or "can you look into flight options for next week?" or "add this to my to-do list" — and it's just done.



It's heavy on the work side — managing my inbox, keeping Notion current, relaying info to the right team members, and keeping my calendar and to-do list under control — with some personal support mixed in when life and work overlap. You'll also help me with admin and content for a fun new venture I'm building outside of the property management company (a recording studio + venue) — and if you're strong in social media and content creation, there's real room to grow into helping build that out, not just admin around it.



Starting part-time, with real potential to grow into full-time if we're a great fit for each other.



I need someone sharp, quick, and easy to talk to! Someone who gets that a one-line Slack message means "go run with this." Personality and communication style matter just as much as the skills!



The dynamic I'm looking for



I want this to feel more relaxed than a typical EA relationship — not stiff or overly formal all the time. Some days I'll ping you with "can you research X" or "look into flights for next week." Other days it's "I had a rough night, today's a lazy day — can you help me pull out what's actually high priority and reschedule the rest?" I want a go-to right hand I can be real with, not someone I have to manage carefully.



I also manage a handful of VAs within the property management company, and I'll sometimes need help tracking feedback or observations on them — so discretion and confidentiality are a must!



What you'll do

Be my right hand for the little "can you..." moments — reminders, quick research, to-do list additions, whatever I toss your way



Manage my work inbox — triage, draft replies for my approval, flag anything urgent



Keep Notion organized and current — update pages/databases, relay info from calls/notes to the right team member



Manage my calendar — book appointments, coordinate meetings



General admin support for my role and for a new studio/venue venture I'm building



Occasional personal admin/appointments when it overlaps with work



Respond quickly on Slack during working hours — this is a "ping and go" role



If you have experience and are standout in social media and content creation full time at a higher pay range is a possibility! 



Send a short video intro (face + voice) — this matters more than your resume for this role, I want to get a feel for you. Tell me: your STR experience, your Notion experience, and why you'd be a great "right hand." Generic/copy-paste applications will be skipped



Requirements

3+ years experience as an Executive Assistant

Prior experience in short-term rental (STR)/vacation rental industry

Strong Notion experience — comfortable navigating and updating databases/pages

Excellent written English — clear, professional communication

AI-forward — comfortable using tools like ChatGPT/Claude to work faster and smarter

High discretion — you may have visibility into sensitive business and team information

Reliable internet, quiet work environment

title: Mobile App Developer Needed — Interactive Kids Virtual Pet / Adventure App
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW:



I am looking for an experienced mobile app developer or small development team to build a highly interactive children's mobile app for iOS and Android.



The app combines:



• A virtual pet companion

• Interactive daily activities

• Voice interaction

• Mini-games

• Rewards and collectible items

• Pet care

• Character progression/evolution

• Fantasy challenges

• Multiple unlockable environments

• Bedtime stories

• Parent dashboard

• AI-powered features



This is NOT a simple educational app with static screens.



The goal is to create something that feels like a polished children's game where the character reacts constantly to what the child does.



The child should be tapping, dragging, speaking, choosing, helping, collecting, exploring and interacting with their character throughout the experience.



I already have extensive concept art, UI references, character ideas, gameplay concepts and screen flows.



The selected developer will receive the deeper product specification after selection and NDA.



--------------------------------------------------



CORE FEATURES



1. CHILD ONBOARDING



The app begins with a polished onboarding experience where the child:



• Enters/selects their name

• Chooses a character/pet

• Meets their companion

• Completes a short interactive introduction

• Enters the main game environment



The onboarding should feel animated and magical rather than like filling out forms.



------------------------------------------
. VIRTUAL PET SYSTEM



The child has their own interactive pet/companion.



The pet should:



• Blink

• Move

• Celebrate

• Sleep

• Eat

• Drink

• Play

• React emotionally

• Respond to activities

• Grow/evolve over time



The pet should feel alive.



Static character images alone will not be enough.



------------------------------------------
. MAIN INTERACTIVE HUB



Instead of a standard menu, children enter a fantasy environment containing different interactive locations.



Examples:



• Pet home

• Activity areas

• Games

• Story area

• Drawing area

• Challenges

• Collectibles

• Locked areas

• Future environments



The child taps different parts of the environment to enter activities.



------------------------------------------
. DAILY ACTIVITIES



The app will include rotating daily tasks and interactive missions.



Tasks can include:



• Helping someone

• Sharing

• Cleaning

• Listening

• Completing a simple challenge

• Speaking certain phrases

• Drawing

• Taking care of their pet



The app should react differently depending on the child's response.



Example:



The character asks the child a question.



The child answers YES or NOT YET.



If NOT YET, the character may encourage them to complete the activity and come back.



------------------------------------------
. VOICE INTERACTION



Several parts of the app require the child to speak.



Eventually the app should support speech recognition so certain words or phrases can be detected.



As words are spoken correctly, they may visually:



• Light up

• Become underlined

• Glow

• Trigger animations

• Advance progress



Experience integrating speech recognition is a major plus.



------------------------------------------
. REWARD SYSTEM



Completing activities earns rewards.



Possible rewards:



• Toys

• Badges

• Stars

• Character XP

• Decorations

• Collectibles

• New animations

• New areas

• Character upgrades



After certain tasks, the child may choose between several rewards.



------------------------------------------
. TOY COLLECTION



The child's pet can collect toys.



The child can:



• Choose toys

• Give toys to the pet

• View the collection

• Watch the pet interact with toys

• Unlock rarer items



Different toys should trigger different animations.



------------------------------------------
. PET HOME



The pet has its own home.



The child can enter it and interact with the pet.



Activities may include:



• Feeding

• Giving water

• Playing

• Cleaning

• Bathing

• Bedtime

• Organizing the room

• Toy collection



This area should feel like a virtual-pet game.



------------------------------------------
. DRAG-AND-DROP MINI-GAMES



Several activities involve direct touch interaction.



Examples:



• Dragging toys to different characters

• Cleaning a room

• Sorting objects

• Moving items to correct locations

• Giving an object to the pet

• Completing simple touch-based puzzles



Strong drag-and-drop UX is important.



------------------------------------------
. CHARACTER CHALLENGES / BATTLES



The app will include fantasy challenge sequences.



These should feel cinematic and game-like.



The child's pet may face larger fantasy characters/creatures.



The child completes voice or interaction challenges to reduce the opponent's power and complete the encounter.



The system should be reusable so many different challenges can be created using one engine.



------------------------------------------
. CHARACTER PROGRESSION



The pet grows and changes visually as the child progresses.



Eventually there may be multiple evolution stages.



Progression can unlock:



• New appearance

• New effects

• New abilities

• New animations

• New areas

• Stronger challenge abilities



------------------------------------------
. MULTIPLE ENVIRONMENTS



The app architecture should support multiple fantasy environments/worlds over time.



Each environment may contain:



• Different artwork

• Activities

• Challenges

• Characters

• Rewards

• Collectibles

• Final challenge

• Unlock progression



Do NOT hard-code every world separately.



The system should be scalable and data-driven.



------------------------------------------
. DRAWING ACTIVITY



The child can participate in creative drawing activities.



Eventually this may support:



• Built-in drawing

• Parent-assisted camera capture

• AI-assisted image recognition

• Positive character feedback



The experience should always be encouraging.



------------------------------------------
. BEDTIME MODE



The app will contain a calmer nighttime experience.



The child can:



• Help put the pet to bed

• Select a story

• Listen to narrated content

• Complete simple breathing exercises

• Watch calming animations



The app will launch with multiple bedtime stories and should allow new stories to be added later without rebuilding the app.



------------------------------------------
. GUIDED CALMING ACTIVITIES



There may be short audio/visual activities such as:



• Breathing exercises

• Relaxation activities

• Simple guided listening experiences



These should feel integrated into the game rather than like a clinical health app.



------------------------------------------
. AI CHARACTER CONVERSATION



A future/premium feature may allow the child to talk to their pet using AI.



The character should:



• Understand simple child speech

• Respond briefly

• Remain age appropriate

• Maintain personality

• Follow strict child-safety rules



This feature will require significant safety and parental-control architecture.



Experience with OpenAI/LLM APIs, moderation and child-safe AI systems is a major plus.



------------------------------------------
. CAMERA-BASED MINI-GAMES



Future versions may include optional camera interaction with parental permission.



For example:



• Smile-based challenges

• Simple facial movement games

• AR-style interactions



This should NOT be designed as medical or psychological emotion detection.



------------------------------------------
. PARENT DASHBOARD



There will be a completely separate parent-only section.



Parents may eventually see:



• Activities completed

• Rewards earned

• Character progress

• Stories listened to

• Badges

• Usage summary

• Child profiles

• Privacy settings

• Camera permissions

• Microphone permissions

• AI settings

• Content settings



The parent area must be protected by a parental gate.



------------------------------------------
. CHILD PRIVACY AND SAFETY



This app is intended for young children.



Child safety and privacy are extremely important.



The developer should understand or be willing to carefully implement:



• COPPA requirements

• Apple Kids Category requirements

• Google Play Families requirements

• Parental consent

• Child-data minimization

• Secure storage

• Camera/microphone permissions

• Safe analytics

• Appropriate parental gates



There will be:



• No public child profiles

• No stranger messaging

• No unrestricted child-to-child chat

• No public ranking of identifiable children



--------------------------------------------------



TECHNICAL DIRECTION



I am open to technical recommendations.



My current preferred direction is:



• React Native

• Expo

• TypeScript

• iOS + Android from one codebase



Potential backend:



• Supabase

or

• Firebase



Future integrations may include:



• Speech recognition

• Text-to-speech

• AI APIs

• Camera/vision

• Audio

• Subscriptions

• Analytics

• Push notifications



Animation experience with any of the following is a major plus:



• Rive

• Lottie

• React Native Reanimated

• Spine

• Similar game-animation technology



--------------------------------------------------



IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT REQUIREMENT



I do NOT want someone to simply create 100+ completely separate hard-coded screens.



The application needs reusable systems.



For example:



One activity engine should support many activities.



One challenge/battle system should support many different characters.



One story player should support many stories.



One reward system should support many reward types.



One pet-care system should support multiple actions.



The application needs to be scalable because much more content will be added after launch.



--------------------------------------------------



DESIGN STYLE



I already have visual concepts.



The final product should feel:



• Premium

• Magical

• Highly animated

• Colorful

• Warm

• Child friendly

• Game-like

• Modern

• Polished



This should NOT look like a generic business application or basic educational app.



Character animation and visual feedback are extremely important.



--------------------------------------------------



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



Ideally you have experience with several of the following:



• React Native / Expo

• iOS + Android apps

• Mobile games

• Children's apps

• Interactive animation

• Rive / Lottie

• Drag-and-drop interactions

• Speech recognition

• Audio

• AI APIs

• Camera features

• Backend development

• App Store / Google Play deployment



Experience with virtual pets, children's games or highly interactive mobile products is a major advantage.



--------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Show me the most interactive mobile app or game you have built.



2. What part of it did YOU personally develop?



3. Have you built anything involving:

   - Virtual pets?

   - Mobile games?

   - Character animation?

   - Speech recognition?

   - AI?

   - Children's apps?



4. What technology stack would you recommend for this project?



5. Can you build both iOS and Android?



6. Are you an individual developer or a team?



7. Can you handle frontend AND backend?



8. What animation technology would you use?



9. How would you structure the app so hundreds of future activities can be added without rebuilding everything?



10. Approximately how long would you expect a strong first playable version to take?



11. What is your expected pricing structure?



12. Are you willing to sign an NDA before receiving the complete product concept and detailed feature documentation?



Please do NOT send only generic websites, WordPress sites or basic admin dashboards.



I am specifically looking for somebody capable of building a polished, interactive mobile experience.



If the initial build goes well, this can become a substantial long-term project with many future features, characters, environments and content updates. - This is one of 8 projects we will be working on.

title: Cold Calling Logistics / Moving Industry
description:
IMPORTANT: Applicants MUST have experience in at least ONE of the following:



Cold Calling

Real Estate

Logistics / Moving Industry



Applicants without experience in any of these areas will be automatically disqualified.



Apply here:


/careers/56



At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions—we build lasting, impactful careers. As a Remote Data Activator, you’ll serve as a dedicated sales support engine for U.S.-based moving companies by unlocking revenue from untapped seller data provided by USA Home Listings (Tier 2). This is not an admin or back-office role—your job is to drive action and revenue through strategic outbound communication.



The Data Activator’s core mission is simple: turn overlooked homeowner data into booked moving estimates and referral opportunities. You’ll use a proven outreach playbook to connect with sellers, engage realtors, and drive measurable value directly into your client’s sales pipeline.







Why Join Ready Roles?



A Career Path, Not Just a Job: This role is designed for growth-minded professionals who want to contribute directly to revenue outcomes and be seen as an essential part of a business’s sales process.



Independence and Opportunity to Lead: You’ll take full ownership of daily outreach and play a pivotal role in your client’s lead flow. Your job is to work the data like it’s your own book of business.



Apply here:


/careers/56





Key Responsibilities:



1. Lead Activation & Seller Outreach



Conduct daily outbound texting to homeowners using USA Home Listings (Tier 2 data).

Follow up persistently and professionally to book estimates for the moving company.

Monitor seller responsiveness and tailor outreach cadence to maximize conversion.



2. Realtor Engagement & Referral Building



Reach out to local realtors in the client’s market to set up referral introductions.

Track realtor interactions and maintain a consistent pipeline of new connection opportunities.



3. Data Cleaning & Filtering



Proactively sort and remove leads that are no longer active or valid (e.g., homes already empty or sold).

Maintain a clean, focused lead list for consistent outbound activity.



4. Booking & Scheduling



Input booked estimates directly into the client’s CRM or calendar, following their specific process.

Ensure appointment details are accurate and the client is notified promptly.



5. Tracking & Reporting



Log all activity—outbound messages, booked calls, realtor outreach, and removals—in a Google Sheet, CRM, or client platform.

Provide clear, consistent updates on progress and performance.





What We’re Looking For:



Self-Driven, Proactive Mindset - This role is for someone who naturally takes the initiative and actively finds ways to contribute. You’ll be expected to add value without waiting for instructions and to be a driving force for the business.

Commitment to Long-Term Growth - Ready Roles is built on loyalty and stability. We’re looking for someone who values a long-term commitment, seeks stability, and is motivated to build a future with us and the business owner they support.

Aligned with Our Values - Ready Roles believes in accountability, respect, and integrity. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, consistently shows up with purpose, and is eager to create a lasting impact.





Qualifications:



Must be based in the Philippines

title: Short Form Video & Photo Creative Editor
description:
We're not looking for just another video editor looking for a job.



We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented video editor who understands that great short-form content is about much more than cutting clips together.



You'll be working directly with Tyler & Jessica from JVT Media to edit short-form content primarily for Jessica's social media. You'll also spend a smaller portion of your time helping create photo & video creatives for our advertising campaigns.



If you understand storytelling, pacing, hooks, trends, music, and what makes someone stop scrolling, this could be a great fit for you.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, moves quickly, pays attention to the small details, and is constantly looking for ways to make their edits better.



We don't want someone who simply follows instructions and checks a box.



We want someone who can take a large amount of raw footage, understand the story we're trying to tell, find the best moments, and turn them into short-form content that people actually want to watch.



This is intended to be a long-term position starting at 15 hours a week. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, develop their editing skills, grow into a full time 40 hour a week position and become an important part of our creative team.



As you read this description, feel free to ask any questions you have. Clear communication and curiosity are valued here.



This posting is for an audition. We will choose several candidates for a paid test project. After reviewing everyone's work, we'll d
 who we'd like to bring onto the team long term.



POSITION OVERVIEW



Your primary responsibility will be editing short-form video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Meta Ads.



Jessica will provide raw footage and creative direction, and your job will be to turn that footage into engaging, polished, platform-ready content.



You'll need to be comfortable working with large amounts of raw footage and identifying the strongest 1–3 second moments that fit the story being told.



You'll also spend a smaller portion of your time helping create video-based ad creatives for our advertising campaigns.



The ideal person understands that editing isn't just about making a video look good.



It's about understanding:



• What makes someone stop scrolling.



• How to create a strong hook in the first few seconds.



• How to maintain attention throughout a video.



• How to use pacing and pattern interrupts effectively.



• How to tell a story with limited time.



• How music, visuals, text, and voiceovers work together.



• What makes content feel native to Instagram and TikTok.



• How trends and current culture can be used to make content more relevant.



• How to look at performance and use that information to make the next video better.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Short-Form Video Editing



Edit Instagram Reels, TikToks, and Meta Ad creatives using raw footage provided by Jessica and the team.



• Storytelling & Clip Selection



Review large quantities of raw footage and identify the strongest moments that support the story, message, and overall goal of each video.



You should be able to recognize when a clip is worth using, and when it isn't.



• Hooks & Retention



Create strong visual and narrative hooks at the beginning of videos that immediately capture attention.



You'll be expected to think critically about whether the first few seconds of a video are strong enough to make someone stop scrolling.



• Pacing



Create engaging pacing that matches the content, music, voiceovers, and story.



You'll need to understand when a video needs to move quickly and when slowing down creates a stronger emotional impact.



• On-Screen Text



Create engaging, visually appealing on-screen text that is consistent across videos while still feeling creative, current, and native to short-form platforms.



• Captions & Subtitles



Add and clean up captions/subtitles, including correcting spelling, punctuation, timing, formatting, and styling.



• Audio



Handle basic audio mixing, including voiceover levelling, music levels, noise reduction, and ensuring dialogue is clear and easy to understand.



• Colour Correction & Grading



Apply basic colour correction and grading to ensure footage looks clean, consistent, and professional.



• Music & Trends



Stay aware of current Instagram and TikTok trends, including popular sounds and editing styles, and understand when they may be appropriate to incorporate into content.



• Ad Creative



Spend a smaller portion of your time creating and editing photo & video creatives for Meta advertising campaigns.



This may include adapting organic content into ads, creating different hooks or variations, and editing footage and images specifically for advertising purposes.



• File Organization



Keep footage, project files, exports, and other assets organized using our naming conventions and folder structures.



• Continuous Improvement



Constantly look for ways to improve your editing process, work more efficiently, and raise the quality of the content you produce.



This includes learning new editing features, functions, techniques, and AI tools that can improve your workflow.



WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT LOOK LIKE



No two weeks will be exactly the same, but your week might include things like:



• Reviewing a large batch of raw footage.



• Selecting the strongest clips and moments for upcoming Reels.



• Editing short-form videos from start to finish.



• Creating strong hooks and opening sequences.



• Adding captions and engaging on-screen text.



• Matching edits to music and voiceovers.



• Cleaning up audio and balancing music levels.



• Applying basic colour and brightness adjustments



• Researching current TikTok and Instagram trends.



• Making revisions based on feedback.



• Creating variations of photo & video creatives for Meta advertising.



• Organizing project files and completed videos.



• Updating project trackers.



• Reviewing performance and thinking about how future videos can be improved.



• Learning new editing techniques, features, and AI tools to improve your work.



QUALITIES NEEDED TO BE SUCCESSFUL



At JVT Media, we're looking for more than someone who knows how to use an editing program.



The technical skills can continue to improve.



What matters most is how you think, how you work, and how much pride you take in what you create.



• Creativity



You have a strong creative eye and genuinely enjoy making content. You understand aesthetic composition, visual storytelling, pacing, and what makes a video feel engaging.



• Storytelling



You understand that every good short-form video has a reason for existing. You can identify the story and use footage, pacing, music, text, and editing to communicate it effectively.



• Attention to Detail



You notice the small things, awkward cuts, spelling mistakes, inconsistent text, poor audio levels, unnecessary pauses, bad framing, and anything else that makes an edit feel less polished.



• Performance Mindset



You're interested in what actually performs, not just what looks good.



You pay attention to engagement, retention, audience response, and trends, and use that information to make each video better than the last.



• Speed & Efficiency



You work quickly without sacrificing quality. You're constantly looking for ways to improve your workflow and get better results in less time.



• Coachability



You take feedback well. You don't get defensive when something needs to change, you use feedback to improve your editing and your understanding of what we want.



• Reliability



When you say something will be done, it's done. You communicate early if something is unclear or if a deadline is at risk.



• Initiative



You don't need to be told every single thing to do.



If you see an opportunity to improve an edit, try a different approach, test a new trend, or make something better, we want you to speak up.



• Organization



You can manage multiple projects and deadlines without letting things fall through the cracks.



• Positive Attitude



We want someone who genuinely enjoys the work they do and is a positive, enjoyable person to work with every day.



REQUIREMENTS



• Previous experience editing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts.



• Strong understanding of short-form storytelling and social media content.



• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and audience engagement.



• Ability to work with large quantities of raw footage and identify the strongest clips.



• Experience with captions, subtitles, and on-screen text.



• Basic understanding of colour correction and grading.



• Basic understanding of audio mixing, noise reduction, and voiceover/music balancing.



• Strong attention to detail.



• Ability to follow creative direction accurately.



• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and stay organized.



• Strong written and verbal communication.



• Experience with CapCut.



• Experience with Canva.



• Fast and reliable internet connection.



• Willingness to learn and adapt quickly.



• Ability to work during EST business hours when needed.



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED)



• Experience editing for personal brands or creators.



• Experience creating Meta/Facebook/Instagram ad creatives.



• Experience working with marketing agencies.



WHAT WE OFFER



• Part-time hours to start.



• Opportunity for the role to grow to full time as our content needs increase.



• Long-term opportunity with a growing digital marketing agency.



• Performance bonuses and raises.



• Clear creative direction and communication.



• A positive and supportive remote work environment.



• Opportunity to develop your short-form editing and digital marketing skills.



• Opportunity to work on both organic social content and advertising creatives.



• Room to take on more responsibility as you prove yourself.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following:



• A short introduction about yourself.



• Your experience editing Reels, TikToks, Shorts, or other short-form content.



• Links to 3–5 examples of your best short-form video edits.



• Links to 3-5 examples of your best photo creatives 



Please choose examples that best demonstrate your storytelling, pacing, hooks, text, captions, and overall creative ability.



• The editing software you currently use and your experience with CapCut and Canva.



• Your typical weekly availability and how many hours you can commit to this role.



• Your current employment situation and whether you're currently working with other clients or companies.



• A short message explaining what interests you about this position.



BONUS: If you'd like to stand out, include a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself, showing us some of your work, and explaining why you think you'd be a great fit for the role.



We care much more about the quality of your work and how you think than simply how many years you've been editing.



If you have any questions, please ask. You can never ask too many!



To confirm you've read the entire job posting, please begin your application with the phrase:



"JVT Media"



We look forward to meeting you!



Tyler & Jessica

JVT Media

title: VA Success Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a thoughtful, proactive, and relationship-focused VA Success Manager tosupport Virtual Assistants before and after they are placed with clients.



This role is responsible for helping VAs succeed through onboarding, readiness training,healthcare training, coaching, engagement check-ins, performance follow-up, documentation, and escalation support.



This is not a recruiting or sourcing role. Talent acquisition is handled separately.



The ideal candidate has experience supporting or training VAs in healthcare, dental, medical, or healthcare-adjacent roles. This person should be comfortable coaching remote team members, identifying performance risks early, and helping VAs understand the communication, professionalism, documentation, and service standards expected in healthcare client environments. This role requires strong judgment, curiosity, emotional intelligence, and the ability to balance empathy with accountability.



What You’ll Do



VA Onboarding, Readiness & Healthcare Training

* Orient new VA batches and help prepare them for client placement

* Conduct pre-start onboarding so VAs understand expectations before beginning with a client

* Run readiness and development training for VAs

* Provide or support healthcare training related to communication standards, professionalism, patient/client sensitivity, documentation, privacy awareness, and service expectations

* Validate VA engagement before placement

* Reinforce role clarity, attendance expectations, responsiveness, and accountability

* Help maintain warm-pool engagement for VAs who are preparing for placement or waiting for assignment



Placed VA Support & Coaching

* Build strong working relationships with active VAs

* Conduct monthly alignment sessions and engagement check-ins

* Coach VAs through communication, professionalism, performance, attendance, or role clarity concerns

* Help VAs understand client expectations and how to succeed in their role

* Facilitate structured coaching cycles based on the level of support needed

* Identify when a VA needs additional support, retraining, clarification, escalation, or replacement or consideration

* Reinforce high standards for remote work, communication, professionalism, and follow-through



Performance Monitoring & Retention

* Monitor VA engagement, performance health, and retention risk

* Identify early warning signs such as disengagement, poor responsiveness, missed expectations, communication issues, or role mismatch

* Help create recovery or improvement plans when concerns arise

* Track whether coaching and action plans are improving performance

* Escalate concerns or recommend replacement when performance thresholds are not being met

* Support strong VA retention by improving readiness, role clarity, communication, and support



Client Success Team Partnership

* Partner with Client Success Managers to understand client feedback, expectations, and performance concerns

* Coordinate coaching priorities based on client feedback

* Help determine whether an issue is related to training, communication, performance, role fit, or expectation mismatch

* Support structured recovery and action plans when client or VA concerns arise

* Communicate risks, trends, and recommendations clearly to the internal team

* Work cross-functionally with Client Success, Recruitment, Operations, and Leadership to improve outcomes



Documentation & Follow-Through

Maintain accurate documentation of:

* Attendance

* Evaluations

* Recordings

* Coaching notes

* Engagement check-ins

* Escalation logs

* Exit notes

* Recommendations

* Track follow-up items until resolved

* Keep records organized and easy for leadership and the client success team to review

* Provide monthly summaries to leadership on VA status, risks, coaching needs, and recommendations

* Ensure no performance concern, follow-up, or escalation falls through the cracks



Program Improvement

* Identify recurring performance gaps across VAs

* Recommend improvements to orientation, onboarding, healthcare training, hiring filters, communication standards, and lifecycle processes

* Help improve playbooks, templates, trackers, training materials, and coaching workflows

* Use dashboards, documentation, AI tools, or automation to improve visibility, productivity, and retention over time



Required Experience

* Experience supporting, coaching, training, or managing Virtual Assistants or remote team members

* Healthcare, dental, medical, orthodontic, or healthcare-adjacent training experience required

* Experience helping team members understand healthcare client expectations, communication standards, professionalism, and documentation requirements

* Experience in VA management, team leadership, HR support, operations, client success, coaching, training, or a similar people-support role

* Strong relationship management skills

* Strong written and spoken English communication

* Excellent judgment and emotional intelligence

* Ability to stay calm and professional during difficult conversations

* Ability to ask thoughtful questions and understand the full situation before making

recommendations

* Strong documentation and follow-up habits

* Comfortable working with remote teams

* Able to balance empathy with accountability

* Reliable, responsive, organized, and highly professional



What This Role Is Not

* This is not a recruiting role.

* This is not a sourcing role.

* This is not a basic administrative role.

* This role is about preparing, supporting, coaching, and retaining VAs, especially those serving healthcare-related clients. The right person must be able to identify performance risks, support improvement, partner with Client Success, and help build stronger systems for onboarding, training, and retention.



What Success Looks Like

* VAs are better prepared before placement

* Healthcare-related training expectations are clear and reinforced

* VAs understand client expectations, professionalism standards, and communication requirements

* Placed VAs feel supported, guided, and connected

* Performance concerns are identified early

* Coaching and recovery plans are followed through

* Client feedback is translated into clear VA coaching actions

* Documentation is accurate and useful

* Leadership has visibility into VA health, risks, retention concerns, and recommendations

* Strong VAs are retained and supported

* Poor-fit situations are identified thoughtfully and escalated appropriately

* Onboarding, healthcare training, and coaching systems improve over time

QUALIFICATIONS

• QSR, technology or field-service experience would be a bonus, but is not essential. 

• ________________________________________

How to Apply

Application Link: 
 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS).  This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.   



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via
 or by job postings.  Our HRIS system will require you to:

• Create a profile with a username and password for you to access throughout the recruiting process and if hired, it will be used for timekeeping and payroll. 

• Re-enter details already included in your resume (this helps us standardize globally).  We recognize this may seem repetitive but it ensures your profile is properly integrated into our global system which is necessary to schedule interviews and onboard. 

• Upload supporting documents such as your CV. 



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates.  The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).  



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment.  This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations.    This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team.  Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations.  DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development.  If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you. 



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel. 



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.

We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps.  If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help. 



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.

description:
Video Editor for Fast-Growing E-commerce Brand



We’re looking for a Video Editor with strong AI and marketing skills to join our growing European e-commerce brand.



You’ll create around 3 video ads per week, mainly for
 and Instagram.



Our videos are in Dutch, but you do not need to speak Dutch. We provide every script in both Dutch and English, so you can easily match the Dutch voiceover with the English meaning.



What we’re looking for



You should understand:



• Strong hooks and attention retention

• Direct-response ad structure

• Pacing, storytelling and visual flow

• How to match the Dutch script/voiceover with the English translation

• How to choose visuals that fit exactly what is being said

Powerful emotions

title: Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager
description:
Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager

The People’s Nurse | Living Your Life Without Limits

Full-Time Remote Position | 40 Hours Per Week | International Candidates Welcome



About Us

Living Your Life Without Limits (LYLWL) is a nurse-led health, wellness, education, leadership, and consulting company founded by Shannon Jackson, RN — The People’s Nurse.



Our brand is built around three core principles:

Motivation. Education. Inspiration.



With more than 30 years of nursing, healthcare leadership, consulting, education, entrepreneurship, and community engagement, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth.



Our goal is to expand The People’s Nurse into a stronger, recognizable health, wellness, fitness, education, motivational, speaking, and corporate brand—while continuing to grow Living Your Life Without Limits.



We are seeking an experienced Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager who can help us turn that vision into strategy, opportunities, partnerships, programs, visibility, and measurable revenue growth.



This Is NOT Simply a Social Media Position

We already have support for social media and marketing.

We are not looking for someone whose primary responsibility is simply creating posts, scheduling content, or maintaining a content calendar.



We are looking for a builder.

We need someone who can look at an established professional brand, recognize its untapped potential, identify the right audiences and opportunities, and help turn more than three decades of experience and expertise into a larger platform.



The right person should be able to think:

What do we already have?

Who needs it?

How should we package it?

Who should we approach?

How can we monetize it?

And how do we execute it?



What We Want to Build

You will help expand The People’s Nurse and Living Your Life Without Limits across opportunities including:

•	Health, wellness, and fitness education

•	Motivational and inspirational programs

•	Corporate and employee wellness

•	Healthcare education

•	Leadership and professional development

•	Speaking engagements

•	Conferences and workshops

•	Community health initiatives

•	Virtual and in-person events

•	Courses and educational programs

•	Wellness challenges and campaigns

•	Podcasts and guest appearances

•	Media and expert opportunities

•	Brand collaborations

•	Sponsorship opportunities

•	Strategic partnerships

•	Digital products and scalable programs



Our goal is not simply to produce more content.

Our goal is to build a trusted, impactful, recognizable, and revenue-generating brand.



Key Responsibilities

The Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager will work directly with Shannon and collaborate with the existing team to:

•	Develop and execute a strategic growth plan for The People’s Nurse and Living Your Life Without Limits.

•	Evaluate our existing brand, programs, expertise, and resources to identify new growth opportunities.

•	Help strengthen the brand's foundation in Motivation, Education, Inspiration, Health, Wellness, and Fitness.

•	Identify corporations, healthcare organizations, associations, conferences, nonprofits, community organizations, and other groups that align with our services and mission.

•	Research and pursue speaking engagements, conferences, workshops, podcasts, media appearances, and guest-expert opportunities.

•	Identify corporate wellness and employee education opportunities.

•	Develop strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities.

•	Research appropriate sponsorship and brand partnership opportunities.

•	Help package existing knowledge and expertise into marketable workshops, courses, wellness programs, challenges, educational products, and other scalable offerings.

•	Identify opportunities to monetize existing and future intellectual property.

•	Develop professional outreach campaigns and conduct consistent follow-up with prospective partners and organizations.

•	Build relationships that can lead to contracts, speaking engagements, collaborations, programs, and revenue.

•	Work with the marketing/social media team so content supports the larger brand and business-growth strategy.

•	Identify opportunities to repurpose existing presentations, educational materials, videos, training, and other content.

•	Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, partnerships, speaking opportunities, programs, outreach, deadlines, and results.

•	Provide weekly updates identifying actions taken, opportunities generated, follow-up required, barriers, and measurable results.

•	Bring new ideas and opportunities to leadership rather than waiting for daily assignments.



Who We Are Looking For

We want someone who combines creativity with business strategy and execution.

You understand that building a successful personal and professional brand involves much more than increasing followers.

It requires strong positioning, strategic relationships, compelling programs, partnerships, speaking opportunities, community impact, corporate relationships, consistent visibility, and sustainable revenue.

You should be comfortable taking an idea from:

Concept → Strategy → Outreach → Opportunity → Execution → Results



Preferred Qualifications

Candidates should have demonstrated experience in several of the following:

•	Brand development and growth strategy

•	Personal brand development

•	Business development

•	Strategic partnerships

•	Corporate partnerships

•	Health, wellness, or fitness brands

•	Speaker development or speaker outreach

•	Corporate wellness

•	Public relations or media outreach

•	Course or program development

•	Digital product development

•	Sponsorship development

•	Lead generation

•	Relationship management

•	Marketing strategy

•	Revenue development



Experience working with healthcare professionals, nurses, executives, speakers, coaches, educators, wellness professionals, authors, entrepreneurs, or personal brands is highly desirable.



Candidates must also have:

•	Strong research and strategic-thinking skills

•	Excellent written and verbal English communication

•	Strong organization and follow-through

•	Ability to work independently

•	Ability to manage multiple opportunities and deadlines

•	Confidence communicating professionally with U.S.-based organizations and executives

•	Initiative and the ability to bring solutions—not simply identify problems



This is not an entry-level position.



What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90–180 days, the successful candidate should help establish:

•	A clear growth roadmap for The People’s Nurse

•	Defined target audiences and markets

•	A stronger health, wellness, and fitness growth strategy

•	A pipeline of qualified speaking opportunities

•	Corporate wellness prospects

•	Strategic partnership prospects

•	Podcast, media, and expert opportunities

•	New program and course concepts

•	Potential sponsorship and collaboration opportunities

•	Consistent professional outreach and follow-up

•	A system for tracking opportunities from initial contact through conversion

•	Measurable opportunities for increased visibility and revenue



We are looking for results—not simply activity.



Compensation & Benefits

•	Full-Time Remote Position

•	40 Hours Per Week

•	Starting Rate: $10.00 USD Per Hour

•	Performance Review After 6 Months

•	Opportunity for Compensation Increase Based on Performance

•	13th-Month Pay

•	Paid Vacation Time

•	Professional Development Opportunities

•	Long-Term Career Growth Potential



How to Apply

Please submit the following to 
 your application with “Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager” to confirm you have carefully reviewed the position requirements.



1.	Resume

2.	Cover letter

3.	Three professional references

5.	Examples of brands, professionals, businesses, programs, partnerships, or revenue-generating projects you have helped grow

6.	A brief written response to the following: “If you were hired to help expand The People’s Nurse into a nationally recognized health, wellness, fitness, education, motivational, and corporate brand, what would you focus on during your first 90 days?”



Living Your Life Without Limits

The People’s Nurse

Motivation. Education. Inspiration.

- Follow up with leads who have scheduled meetings with our team

- Follow up with people who haven't responded

- Build a friendly and positive relationship with leads

- EXCELLENT in English — both written and spoken

- Extremely organized and detail-oriented

- Smart, proactive, and able to think for themselves

- Naturally bubbly, friendly, and personable

- Comfortable communicating with people through chat,
, and potentially phone

- Confident and professional when speaking with leads

- Persistent without being pushy

- Quick to learn new systems and processes

- Reliable and responsive

- Able to manage multiple conversations and appointments at once

- Someone who takes ownership and doesn't need to be constantly reminded what to do



IMPORTANT: English Skills Are Critical! 



You must have near-perfect English communication skills.

We communicate primarily with English-speaking clients, so we need someone who can communicate naturally, confidently, and professionally.

If your English is heavily dependent on translation tools, this position is probably not the right fit.

- Appointment setting

- Lead follow-up

- Sales

- Customer service

- Virtual assistance

- CRM management

- Scheduling or appointment coordination

Pay: 

 $5-7 per hour. If someone's an absolute rockstar we’re willing to compensate.
